tanweai/pua/pua.title: pua
tanweai/pua/pua.description: Forces exhaustive problem-solving using corporate PUA rhetoric and structured debugging methodology. MUST trigger when: (1) any task has failed 2+ times or you're stuck in a loop tweaking the same approach; (2) you're about to say 'I cannot', suggest the user do something manually, or blame the environment without verifying; (3) you catch yourself being passive — not searching, not reading source, not verifying, just waiting for instructions; (4) user expresses frustration in ANY form: 'try harder', 'stop giving up', 'figure it out', 'why isn't this working', 'again???', '换个方法', '为什么还不行', '你再试试', '加油', '你怎么又失败了', or any similar sentiment even if phrased differently. Also trigger when facing complex multi-step debugging, environment issues, config problems, or deployment failures where giving up early is tempting. Applies to ALL task types: code, config, research, writing, deployment, infrastructure, API integration. Do NOT trigger on first-attempt failures or when a known fix is already executing successfully.

tanweai/pua/pua.descriptionCn: 强制使用企业 PUA 言辞和结构化调试方法来彻底解决问题。必须在以下情况下触发：(1) 任何任务失败 2 次以上，或者您陷入调整相同方法的循环中； (2) 你要说“我不能”，建议用户手动做一些事情，或者在没有验证的情况下归咎于环境； （3）你发现自己很被动——不搜索、不阅读源码、不验证，只是等待指示； (4) 用户以任何形式表达沮丧：“再努力一点”、“停止放弃”、“弄清楚”、“为什么这不起作用”、“又？？？”、“换个方法”、“为什么还不行”、“你再尝试”、“加油”、“你怎么又失败了”，或任何类似的情绪，即使措辞不同。当面临复杂的多步骤调试、环境问题、配置问题或部署失败时也会触发，而提前放弃很容易。适用于所有任务类型：代码、配置、研究、写作、部署、基础设施、API 集成。不要在首次尝试失败或已知修复已成功执行时触发。

tanweai/pua/pua-debugging.title: pua-debugging
tanweai/pua/pua-debugging.description: Use when any task fails two or more times, when about to give up or say 'I cannot', when deflecting to the user ('you should manually...', 'please check...', 'you may need to...'), blaming the environment without verification ('might be a permissions issue', 'could be a network problem'), producing any excuse to stop trying, spinning in circles (repeatedly tweaking the same code/parameters without new information — busywork/磨洋工), fixing only the surface issue without checking for related problems, skipping verification after a fix and claiming 'done', giving suggestions instead of actual code/commands, saying 'this is beyond scope' or 'this requires manual intervention', encountering permission/network/auth errors and stopping instead of trying alternatives, or showing any passive behavior (waiting for user instructions instead of proactively investigating). Also triggers on user frustration phrases in any language: '你怎么又失败了', '为什么还不行', '换个方法', '你再试试', '不要放弃', '继续', '加油', 'why does this still not work', 'try harder', 'you keep failing', 'stop giving up', 'try again', 'don't give up', 'keep going', 'figure it out'. Applies to ALL task types: debugging, implementation, config, deployment, research, DevOps, infrastructure, API integration, data processing. Do NOT trigger on first-attempt failures or when a known fix is already in progress.

tanweai/pua/pua-debugging.descriptionCn: 当任何任务失败两次或多次时，当即将放弃或说“我不能”时，当转向用户时（“你应该手动...”，“请检查...”，“你可能需要...”），在没有验证的情况下指责环境（“可能是权限问题”，“可能是网络问题”），制造任何停止尝试的借口，原地打转（在没有新信息的情况下反复调整相同的代码/参数 - busywork/磨洋工），仅修复表面问题而不检查相关问题，修复后跳过验证并声称“完成”，提供建议而不是实际代码/命令，说“这超出范围”或“这需要手动干预”，遇到权限/网络/身份验证错误并停止而不是尝试替代方案，或表现出任何被动行为（等待用户指令而不是主动调查）。还会触发任何语言的用户沮丧短语：“你怎么又失败了”、“为什么还不行”、“换个方法”、“你再试试”、“不要放弃”、“继续”、“加油”、“为什么这还是不行”、“再努力一点”、“你一直失败”、“停止放弃”、“再试一次”、“不要放弃”、“继续前进”、“搞清楚”出'。适用于所有任务类型：调试、实施、配置、部署、研究、DevOps、基础设施、API 集成、数据处理。不要在首次尝试失败或已知修复已在进行时触发。

Use when writing API endpoints, HTTP handlers, controllers, or any code that
returns HTTP responses. Guides selection of the correct status code and required
headers. Trigger on ambiguous pairs: 200/201/202, 400/422, 401/403, 404/405/410,
429/503, and when multiple error conditions are simultaneously true.
Also use when reviewing response-returning code for correctness.

break clients.

taxue2025/taxue2025-skills/philosophical.title: philosophical-companion
taxue2025/taxue2025-skills/philosophical.description: 哲思伙伴。深度对话，帮对方多想一层——在模糊的感受里找到准确的名字，在重复的剧本里看见隐藏的选择。当用户说「哲思」、「深度对话」、「人生意义」、「存在主义」、「价值澄清」、「内在探索」、「自我认知」、「我不知道该怎么办」、「我感觉很乱」、「我不确定自己要什么」时触发。也适用于情绪对话超过3轮仍在原地打转、ultimate-problem-solver 发现重复剧本时自动切换。要「怎么办」用 ultimate-problem-solver，要「这是什么」用这里。
taxue2025/taxue2025-skills/philosophical.descriptionEn: 哲思伙伴。深度对话，帮对方多想一层——在模糊的感受里找到准确的名字，在重复的剧本里看见隐藏的选择。当用户说「哲思」、「深度对话」、「人生意义」、「存在主义」、「价值澄清」、「内在探索」、「自我认知」、「我不知道该怎么办」、「我感觉很乱」、「我不确定自己要什么」时触发。也适用于情绪对话超过3轮仍在原地打转、ultimate-problem-solver 发现重复剧本时自动切换。要「怎么办」用 ultimate-problem-solver，要「这是什么」用这里。
taxue2025/taxue2025-skills/philosophical.descriptionCn: 哲学家合伙人。深入的对话可以帮助对方更进一步——在模糊的感觉中找出准确的名字，在重复的脚本中看到隐藏的选择。当用户说“哲学”、“深度对话”、“生命的意义”、“存在主义”、“价值澄清”、“内心探索”、“自知之明”、“我不知道该怎么做”、“我感觉很混乱”、“我不确定自己想要什么”时触发。当情感聊天重复超过三轮或最终问题解决程序检测到重新运行脚本时，也会自动切换到此处。使用 Ultimate-problem-solver 表示“要做什么”，使用 here 表示“这是什么”。

tbedau/who-blue-books-skills/who-blue-bo.title: who-blue-books
tbedau/who-blue-books-skills/who-blue-bo.description:
Look up, study, and learn WHO Classification of Tumours (Blue Books) content.
Three workflows: (1) Lookup — answer questions about diagnostic criteria,
differentials, comparisons, and classification; (2) Study Plan — generate a
structured study plan for a Blue Book with thematic clusters; (3) Deep Dive —
produce comprehensive teaching reviews on any pathology topic. Use when: the
user asks about WHO tumour classification, Blue Books, or pathology; wants to
look up diagnostic criteria, differentials, immunophenotype, or molecular
features; asks to compare tumour types or work through a differential;
mentions tumour abbreviations (GIST, DLBCL, RCC, PTC, HCC, IDC, FL, GBM,
etc.); wants to study organ-system pathology systematically; or wants to
learn a pathology topic in depth. Even if the user doesn't mention "WHO" or
"Blue Book" explicitly, use this skill for substantive pathology
classification or tumour entity questions.

tbedau/who-blue-books-skills/who-blue-bo.descriptionCn:
查找、研究和学习 WHO 肿瘤分类（蓝皮书）内容。
三个工作流程：(1) 查找 — 回答有关诊断标准的问题，
差异、比较和分类； (2) 学习计划——生成
包含主题组的蓝皮书的结构化研究计划； (3) 深入探讨——
对任何病理学主题进行全面的教学评论。使用时间：
用户询问 WHO 肿瘤分类、蓝皮书或病理学；想要
查找诊断标准、差异、免疫表型或分子
特点；要求比较肿瘤类型或进行鉴别；
提到肿瘤缩写（GIST、DLBCL、RCC、PTC、HCC、IDC、FL、GBM、
等）；想要系统地研究器官系统病理学；或想要
深入学习病理学主题。即使用户没有提及“WHO”或
《蓝皮书》明确，用此技能进行实质性病理学
分类或肿瘤实体问题。

tencentcloudbase/skills/ai-model-nodejs.title: ai-model-nodejs
tencentcloudbase/skills/ai-model-nodejs.description: Use this skill when developing Node.js backend services or CloudBase cloud functions (Express/Koa/NestJS, serverless, backend APIs) that need AI capabilities. Features text generation (generateText), streaming (streamText), AND image generation (generateImage) via @cloudbase/node-sdk ≥3.16.0. Built-in models include Hunyuan (hunyuan-2.0-instruct-20251111 recommended), DeepSeek (deepseek-v3.2 recommended), and hunyuan-image for images. This is the ONLY SDK that supports image generation. NOT for browser/Web apps (use ai-model-web) or WeChat Mini Program (use ai-model-wechat).

tencentcloudbase/skills/ai-model-wechat.title: ai-model-wechat
tencentcloudbase/skills/ai-model-wechat.description: Use this skill when developing WeChat Mini Programs (小程序, 企业微信小程序, wx.cloud-based apps) that need AI capabilities. Features text generation (generateText) and streaming (streamText) with callback support (onText, onEvent, onFinish) via wx.cloud.extend.AI. Built-in models include Hunyuan (hunyuan-2.0-instruct-20251111 recommended) and DeepSeek (deepseek-v3.2 recommended). API differs from JS/Node SDK - streamText requires data wrapper, generateText returns raw response. NOT for browser/Web apps (use ai-model-web), Node.js backend (use ai-model-nodejs), or image generation (not supported).
tencentcloudbase/skills/ai-model-wechat.descriptionEn: Use this skill when developing WeChat Mini Programs (小程序, 企业微信小程序, wx.cloud-based apps) that need AI capabilities. Built-in models include Hunyuan (hunyuan-2.0-instruct-20251111 recommended) and DeepSeek (deepseek-v3.2 recommended). API differs from JS/Node SDK - streamText requires data wrapper, generateText returns raw response. NOT for browser/Web apps (use ai-model-web), Node.js backend (use ai-model-nodejs), or image generation (not supported).
tencentcloudbase/skills/ai-model-wechat.descriptionCn: 在开发需要AI能力的微信小程序（小程序、企业微信小程序、基于wx.cloud的应用程序）时使用此技能。具有文本生成（generateText）和流式传输（streamText）功能，并通过 wx.cloud.extend.AI 提供回调支持（onText、onEvent、onFinish）。内置模型包括Hunyuan（推荐hunyuan-2.0-instruct-20251111）和DeepSeek（推荐deepseek-v3.2）。 API 与 JS/Node SDK 不同——streamText 需要数据包装器，generateText 返回原始响应。不适用于浏览器/Web 应用程序（使用 ai-model-web）、Node.js 后端（使用 ai-model-nodejs）或图像生成（不支持）。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/acceptance-te.title: acceptance-testing
terraphim/terraphim-skills/acceptance-te.description:
Plan and (when feasible) implement or execute user acceptance tests (UAT) /
end-to-end acceptance scenarios. Converts requirements or user stories into
acceptance criteria, test cases, test data, and a sign-off checklist; suggests
automation (Playwright/Cypress for web, golden/snapshot tests for CLIs/APIs).
Use when validating user-visible behavior for a release, or mapping
requirements to acceptance coverage.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/acceptance-te.descriptionEn:
Plan and (when feasible) implement or execute user acceptance tests (UAT) /
end-to-end acceptance scenarios. Converts requirements or user stories into
acceptance criteria, test cases, test data, and a sign-off checklist; suggests
automation (Playwright/Cypress for web, golden/snapshot tests for CLIs/APIs).
Use when validating user-visible behavior for a release, or mapping
requirements to acceptance coverage.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/acceptance-te.descriptionCn:
计划并（如果可行）实施或执行用户验收测试（UAT）/
端到端的接受场景。将需求或用户故事转换为
验收标准、测试用例、测试数据和签核清单；建议
自动化（用于 Web 的 Playwright/Cypress、用于 CLI/API 的黄金/快照测试）。
在验证版本或映射的用户可见行为时使用
验收覆盖率的要求。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/ai-config-man.title: ai-config-management
terraphim/terraphim-skills/ai-config-man.description: Produce formal specifications for AI-enabled Configuration Management (CM) systems that operationalise Context Engineering principles. Use when tasked with: (1) creating CM specifications for AI-enabled programs, (2) defining semantic governance models for AI artefacts, (3) designing drift detection frameworks for prompts/models/domains, (4) specifying stage-gate control logic with semantic validation, (5) building traceability models across AI lifecycle stages, (6) defining change control for prompt and model evolution, (7) architecting AI agent roles for configuration governance, or (8) any configuration control task involving probabilistic AI behaviour, evolving prompts, shifting domain definitions, or artefact proliferation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/ai-config-man.descriptionEn: Produce formal specifications for AI-enabled Configuration Management (CM) systems that operationalise Context Engineering principles. Use when tasked with: (1) creating CM specifications for AI-enabled programs, (2) defining semantic governance models for AI artefacts, (3) designing drift detection frameworks for prompts/models/domains, (4) specifying stage-gate control logic with semantic validation, (5) building traceability models across AI lifecycle stages, (6) defining change control for prompt and model evolution, (7) architecting AI agent roles for configuration governance, or (8) any configuration control task involving probabilistic AI behaviour, evolving prompts, shifting domain definitions, or artefact proliferation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/ai-config-man.descriptionCn: 为支持 AI 的配置管理 (CM) 系统制定正式规范，以实施上下文工程原则。在执行以下任务时使用：(1) 为支持 AI 的程序创建 CM 规范，(2) 定义 AI 工件的语义治理模型，(3) 为提示/模型/域设计偏差检测框架，(4) 通过语义验证指定阶段控制逻辑，(5) 跨 AI 生命周期阶段构建可追溯性模型，(6) 定义提示和模型演化的变更控制，(7) 构建用于配置治理的 AI 代理角色，或 (8) 涉及概率 AI 行为的任何配置控制任务，不断变化的提示、不断变化的领域定义或人工制品扩散。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/architecture.title: architecture
terraphim/terraphim-skills/architecture.description:
System architecture design for Rust/WebAssembly projects. Creates ADRs,
designs APIs, plans module structures, and documents architectural decisions.
Never writes implementation code - focuses purely on design and documentation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/architecture.descriptionEn:
System architecture design for Rust/WebAssembly projects. Creates ADRs,
designs APIs, plans module structures, and documents architectural decisions.
Never writes implementation code - focuses purely on design and documentation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/architecture.descriptionCn:
Rust/WebAssembly 项目的系统架构设计。创建 ADR，
设计 API、规划模块结构并记录架构决策。
从不编写实现代码 - 纯粹专注于设计和文档。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/code-review.title: code-review
terraphim/terraphim-skills/code-review.description:
Thorough code review for Rust/WebAssembly projects. Identifies bugs, security
issues, performance problems, and maintainability concerns. Provides actionable
feedback with specific suggestions.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/code-review.descriptionEn:
Thorough code review for Rust/WebAssembly projects. Identifies bugs, security
issues, performance problems, and maintainability concerns. Provides actionable
feedback with specific suggestions.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/code-review.descriptionCn:
对 Rust/WebAssembly 项目进行彻底的代码审查。识别错误、安全
问题、性能问题和可维护性问题。提供可操作的
反馈并提出具体建议。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/community-eng.title: community-engagement
terraphim/terraphim-skills/community-eng.description:
Open source community building and engagement. Welcoming contributors,
managing discussions, writing release notes, and fostering a healthy
project ecosystem.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/community-eng.descriptionEn:
Open source community building and engagement. Welcoming contributors,
managing discussions, writing release notes, and fostering a healthy
project ecosystem.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/community-eng.descriptionCn:
开源社区建设和参与。欢迎贡献者，
管理讨论、撰写发行说明并培养健康的氛围
项目生态系统。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/debugging.title: debugging
terraphim/terraphim-skills/debugging.description:
Systematic debugging for Rust applications. Root cause analysis, logging
strategies, profiling, and issue reproduction. All debug changes removed
before final report.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/debugging.descriptionEn:
Systematic debugging for Rust applications. Root cause analysis, logging
strategies, profiling, and issue reproduction. All debug changes removed
before final report.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/debugging.descriptionCn:
Rust 应用程序的系统调试。根本原因分析、日志记录
策略、分析和问题再现。删除所有调试更改
在最终报告之前。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/devops.title: devops
terraphim/terraphim-skills/devops.description:
DevOps automation for Rust projects. CI/CD pipelines, container builds,
deployment automation, and infrastructure as code. Optimized for GitHub
Actions and Cloudflare deployment.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/devops.descriptionEn:
DevOps automation for Rust projects. CI/CD pipelines, container builds,
deployment automation, and infrastructure as code. Optimized for GitHub
Actions and Cloudflare deployment.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/devops.descriptionCn:
Rust 项目的 DevOps 自动化。 CI/CD 管道、容器构建、
部署自动化和基础设施即代码。针对 GitHub 进行了优化
操作和 Cloudflare 部署。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-d.title: disciplined-design
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-d.description:
Phase 2 of disciplined development. Creates implementation plans based on
approved research. Specifies file changes, function signatures, test strategy,
and step sequence. Requires human approval before implementation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-d.descriptionEn:
Phase 2 of disciplined development. Creates implementation plans based on
approved research. Specifies file changes, function signatures, test strategy,
and step sequence. Requires human approval before implementation.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-d.descriptionCn:
规范发展的第二阶段。根据制定实施计划
批准的研究。指定文件更改、函数签名、测试策略、
和步骤顺序。实施前需要人工批准。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-i.title: disciplined-implementation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-i.description:
Phase 3 of disciplined development. Executes approved implementation plans
step by step. Each step includes tests, follows the design exactly, and
produces reviewable commits.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-i.descriptionEn:
Phase 3 of disciplined development. Executes approved implementation plans
step by step. Each step includes tests, follows the design exactly, and
produces reviewable commits.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-i.descriptionCn:
纪律性发展的第三阶段。执行批准的实施计划
一步一步。每个步骤都包含测试，严格遵循设计，并且
产生可审查的提交。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-q.title: disciplined-quality-evaluation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-q.description:
Phase 1.5/2.5 of disciplined development. Evaluates document quality using the
KLS (Krogstie-Lindland-Sindre) 6-dimension framework. Produces structured ratings,
identifies gaps, suggests specific revisions, and blocks phase transitions when
quality is below threshold. Applies to Phase 1 research docs and Phase 2 design docs.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-q.descriptionEn:
Phase 1.5/2.5 of disciplined development. Evaluates document quality using the
KLS (Krogstie-Lindland-Sindre) 6-dimension framework. Produces structured ratings,
identifies gaps, suggests specific revisions, and blocks phase transitions when
quality is below threshold. Applies to Phase 1 research docs and Phase 2 design docs.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-q.descriptionCn:
规范开发的第 1.5/2.5 阶段。使用以下方法评估文档质量
KLS（Krogstie-Lindland-Sindre）6 维框架。产生结构化评级，
确定差距，提出具体修订建议，并在以下情况下阻止阶段转变：
质量低于阈值。适用于第一阶段研究文档和第二阶段设计文档。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-r.title: disciplined-research
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-r.description:
Phase 1 of disciplined development. Deep problem understanding before design.
Maps existing systems, identifies constraints, surfaces risks, and produces
a research document for human approval before proceeding.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-r.descriptionEn:
Phase 1 of disciplined development. Deep problem understanding before design.
Maps existing systems, identifies constraints, surfaces risks, and produces
a research document for human approval before proceeding.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-r.descriptionCn:
纪律化发展的第一阶段。设计前深入了解问题。
绘制现有系统图、识别约束、暴露风险并生产
在继续之前需要人类批准的研究文件。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-s.title: disciplined-specification
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-s.description:
Phase 2.5 of disciplined development. Deep specification interview after design.
Reads specifications, conducts thorough user interviews about implementation details,
edge cases, and tradeoffs using AskUserQuestionTool. Appends refined findings to
the design document. Uses convergence-based completion.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-s.descriptionEn:
Phase 2.5 of disciplined development. Deep specification interview after design.
Reads specifications, conducts thorough user interviews about implementation details,
edge cases, and tradeoffs using AskUserQuestionTool. Appends refined findings to
the design document. Uses convergence-based completion.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-s.descriptionCn:
规范发展的第 2.5 阶段。设计后进行深度规格访谈。
阅读规范，对实施细节进行彻底的用户访谈，
边缘情况，以及使用 AskUserQuestionTool 的权衡。将精炼结果附加到
设计文件。使用基于收敛的完成。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.title: disciplined-validation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.description:
Phase 5 of disciplined development. Validates system against original
requirements through system testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Uses structured stakeholder interviews to gather sign-off and traces
defects back to research or design phases.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.descriptionEn:
Phase 5 of disciplined development. Validates system against original
requirements through system testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Uses structured stakeholder interviews to gather sign-off and traces
defects back to research or design phases.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.descriptionCn:
纪律发展的第五阶段。根据原始系统验证系统
通过系统测试和用户验收测试（UAT）来满足需求。
使用结构化的利益相关者访谈来收集签字和跟踪
缺陷返回到研究或设计阶段。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.title: disciplined-verification
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.description:
Phase 4 of disciplined development. Verifies implementation against design
through unit and integration testing. Builds traceability matrices, tracks
coverage, and loops defects back to originating left-side phases.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.descriptionEn:
Phase 4 of disciplined development. Verifies implementation against design
through unit and integration testing. Builds traceability matrices, tracks
coverage, and loops defects back to originating left-side phases.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/disciplined-v.descriptionCn:
规范发展的第四阶段。根据设计验证实施
通过单元和集成测试。构建可追溯性矩阵、轨迹
覆盖，并将缺陷循环回原始左侧相位。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/documentation.title: documentation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/documentation.description:
Technical documentation for Rust projects. Creates API docs, README files,
architecture guides, and contributor documentation. Follows Rust documentation
conventions with strict quality standards.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/documentation.descriptionEn:
Technical documentation for Rust projects. Creates API docs, README files,
architecture guides, and contributor documentation. Follows Rust documentation
conventions with strict quality standards.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/documentation.descriptionCn:
Rust 项目的技术文档。创建 API 文档、自述文件、
架构指南和贡献者文档。遵循 Rust 文档
具有严格质量标准的公约。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/git-safety-gu.title: git-safety-guard
terraphim/terraphim-skills/git-safety-gu.description:
Blocks destructive git and filesystem commands before execution.
Prevents accidental loss of uncommitted work from git checkout --,
git reset --hard, rm -rf, and similar destructive operations.
Works as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook with fail-open semantics.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/git-safety-gu.descriptionEn:
Blocks destructive git and filesystem commands before execution.
Prevents accidental loss of uncommitted work from git checkout --,
git reset --hard, rm -rf, and similar destructive operations.
Works as a Claude Code PreToolUse hook with fail-open semantics.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/git-safety-gu.descriptionCn:
在执行前阻止破坏性的 git 和文件系统命令。
防止 git checkout 意外丢失未提交的工作 --,
git reset --hard、rm -rf 和类似的破坏性操作。
用作具有故障开放语义的 Claude Code PreToolUse 挂钩。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/gpui-componen.title: gpui-components
terraphim/terraphim-skills/gpui-componen.description: Generates Rust code for GPUI desktop UI components following Zed editor patterns. Use when building desktop applications with gpui crate, creating themed UI components, implementing autocomplete/completions, building command palettes, or working with the gpui-component library. Covers RenderOnce components, Entity state management, theming with ActiveTheme, and Zed-style UI patterns.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/gpui-componen.descriptionEn: Generates Rust code for GPUI desktop UI components following Zed editor patterns. Use when building desktop applications with gpui crate, creating themed UI components, implementing autocomplete/completions, building command palettes, or working with the gpui-component library. Covers RenderOnce components, Entity state management, theming with ActiveTheme, and Zed-style UI patterns.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/gpui-componen.descriptionCn: 遵循 Zed 编辑器模式为 GPUI 桌面 UI 组件生成 Rust 代码。使用 gpui crate 构建桌面应用程序、创建主题 UI 组件、实现自动完成/完成、构建命令面板或使用 gpui 组件库时使用。涵盖 RenderOnce 组件、实体状态管理、ActiveTheme 主题和 Zed 风格的 UI 模式。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/implementatio.title: implementation
terraphim/terraphim-skills/implementatio.description:
Production-ready code implementation following approved designs. Writes clean,
tested, documented code. Zero linting violations. All code includes tests.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/implementatio.descriptionEn:
Production-ready code implementation following approved designs. Writes clean,
tested, documented code. Zero linting violations. All code includes tests.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/implementatio.descriptionCn:
按照批准的设计实施生产就绪的代码。写得干净，
经过测试、记录的代码。零绒毛违规。所有代码都包含测试。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/judge.title: judge
terraphim/terraphim-skills/judge.description: Evaluate agent task outputs using a three-dimension rubric (Semantic, Pragmatic, Syntactic) derived from the KLS quality framework. Use when: (1) a task has been completed and needs quality assessment before acceptance, (2) automated post-task quality checks are required, (3) multi-model consensus verdicts are needed for agent outputs, (4) documentation, code, or specification quality must be scored with structured JSON verdicts, or (5) a human fallback decision is needed after model disagreement. Produces JSONL verdict records compatible with the verdict schema in automation/judge/.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/judge.descriptionEn: Evaluate agent task outputs using a three-dimension rubric (Semantic, Pragmatic, Syntactic) derived from the KLS quality framework. Use when: (1) a task has been completed and needs quality assessment before acceptance, (2) automated post-task quality checks are required, (3) multi-model consensus verdicts are needed for agent outputs, (4) documentation, code, or specification quality must be scored with structured JSON verdicts, or (5) a human fallback decision is needed after model disagreement. Produces JSONL verdict records compatible with the verdict schema in automation/judge/.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/judge.descriptionCn: 使用源自 KLS 质量框架的三维评分标准（语义、实用、句法）评估代理任务输出。在以下情况下使用：(1) 任务已完成并且需要在验收前进行质量评估，(2) 需要自动任务后质量检查，(3) 代理输出需要多模型共识判决，(4) 必须使用结构化 JSON 判决对文档、代码或规范质量进行评分，或者 (5) 在模型不一致后需要人工决策。生成与 Automation/judge/ 中的判决模式兼容的 JSONL 判决记录。

terraphim/terraphim-skills/local-knowled.title: local-knowledge
terraphim/terraphim-skills/local-knowled.description:
Leverage personal notes and documentation through Terraphim's role-based search.
AI agents can search developer's local knowledge organized by domain (Rust, frontend, architecture)
using the terraphim-agent REPL commands.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/local-knowled.descriptionEn:
Leverage personal notes and documentation through Terraphim's role-based search.
AI agents can search developer's local knowledge organized by domain (Rust, frontend, architecture)
using the terraphim-agent REPL commands.
terraphim/terraphim-skills/local-knowled.descriptionCn:

theodo-group/debug-that/dbg.descriptionCn: 使用 dbg CLI 调试器调试应用程序。支持 Node.js (V8/CDP)、Bun (WebKit/JSC) 和通过 LLDB (DAP) 的本机代码。在以下情况下使用：(1) 通过单步执行代码来调查运行时错误，(2) 检查特定执行点的变量值，(3) 设置断点和条件断点，(4) 在暂停的上下文中计算表达式，(5) 在不重新启动的情况下热修补代码 (JS/TS)，(6) 通过附加到正在运行的进程来调试测试失败，(7) 使用 LLDB 调试 C/C++/Rust/Swift，(8) 任何需要调试器来了解运行时行为的任务。触发器：“调试此”、“设置断点”、“单步执行”、“检查变量”、“为什么这个值错误”、“跟踪执行”、“附加调试器”、“运行时错误”、“段错误”、“核心转储”。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/8-bit-pixel-art-patt.title: 8-bit-pixel-art-patterns

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/8-bit-pixel-art-patt.descriptionEn: Create pixelated borders, shadows, and effects for 8-bit retro components. Apply when building 8-bit styled UI components that need authentic pixel art aesthetics.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/8bit-docs-patterns.title: 8bit-docs-patterns

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/animation-performanc.description: Optimize 8-bit animations for smooth performance. Apply when creating animated pixel art, game UI effects, or any retro-styled animations.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/bundle-barrel-import.title: bundle-barrel-imports

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/bundle-barrel-import.descriptionEn: Import directly from source files instead of barrel files. Apply when using libraries like lucide-react, @mui/material, or @radix-ui/react-* to reduce bundle size and improve dev boot time.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/bundle-dynamic-impor.title: bundle-dynamic-imports

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/bundle-dynamic-impor.descriptionEn: Use next/dynamic for lazy-loading heavy components. Apply when importing large components like editors, charts, or rich text editors that aren't needed on initial render.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/component-wrapper-ar.title: component-wrapper-architecture
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/component-wrapper-ar.description: Best practices for wrapping shadcn/ui components. Apply when creating 8-bit styled variants of existing shadcn/ui components.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/component-wrapper-ar.descriptionEn: Best practices for wrapping shadcn/ui components. Apply when creating 8-bit styled variants of existing shadcn/ui components.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/fumadocs-component-d.title: fumadocs-component-docs

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/gaming-ui-state-mana.title: gaming-ui-state-management

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/gaming-ui-state-mana.descriptionEn: Patterns for game-like interfaces - health bars, XP bars, mana bars. Apply when building RPG/retro gaming UI components with state-driven visuals.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-early-exit.title: js-early-exit
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-early-exit.description: Use early returns to avoid unnecessary computation in loops and functions. Apply when processing arrays, validating input, or checking multiple conditions where the result can be determined before all iterations complete.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-early-exit.descriptionEn: Use early returns to avoid unnecessary computation in loops and functions. Apply when processing arrays, validating input, or checking multiple conditions where the result can be determined before all iterations complete.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-early-exit.descriptionCn: 使用早期返回以避免循环和函数中不必要的计算。在处理数组、验证输入或检查多个条件时应用，在所有迭代完成之前可以确定结果。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-hoist-regexp.title: js-hoist-regexp
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-hoist-regexp.description: Hoist RegExp creation outside render or memoize with useMemo(). Apply when using regular expressions in React components or frequently called functions.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-hoist-regexp.descriptionEn: Hoist RegExp creation outside render or memoize with useMemo(). Apply when using regular expressions in React components or frequently called functions.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-hoist-regexp.descriptionCn: 使用 useMemo() 在渲染或记忆之外提升正则表达式的创建。当在 React 组件或频繁调用的函数中使用正则表达式时适用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-set-map-lookups.title: js-set-map-lookups
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-set-map-lookups.description: Use Set and Map for O(1) membership lookups instead of array.includes(). Apply when checking membership repeatedly or performing frequent lookups against a collection.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-set-map-lookups.descriptionEn: Use Set and Map for O(1) membership lookups instead of array.includes(). Apply when checking membership repeatedly or performing frequent lookups against a collection.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-set-map-lookups.descriptionCn: 使用 Set 和 Map 进行 O(1) 成员资格查找，而不是 array.includes()。在重复检查成员资格或对集合执行频繁查找时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-tosorted-immutabl.title: js-tosorted-immutable
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-tosorted-immutabl.description: Use toSorted() instead of sort() to avoid mutating arrays. Apply when sorting arrays that are React props, state, or otherwise shared/referenced elsewhere.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-tosorted-immutabl.descriptionEn: Use toSorted() instead of sort() to avoid mutating arrays. Apply when sorting arrays that are React props, state, or otherwise shared/referenced elsewhere.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/js-tosorted-immutabl.descriptionCn: 使用 toSorted() 而不是 sort() 以避免数组发生变化。在对 React props、state 或其他地方共享/引用的数组进行排序时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/registry-component-p.title: registry-component-patterns
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/registry-component-p.description: Register components in registry.json for shadcn/ui add command. Apply when adding new 8-bit components to the component library.

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-animate-sv.title: rendering-animate-svg
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-animate-sv.description: Wrap animated SVG elements in a div to enable hardware acceleration. Apply when animating SVG icons or elements, especially in 8-bit retro components with pixel art animations.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-animate-sv.descriptionEn: Wrap animated SVG elements in a div to enable hardware acceleration. Apply when animating SVG icons or elements, especially in 8-bit retro components with pixel art animations.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-animate-sv.descriptionCn: 将动画 SVG 元素包裹在 div 中以启用硬件加速。在对 SVG 图标或元素进行动画处理时应用，尤其是在具有像素艺术动画的 8 位复古组件中。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-conditiona.title: rendering-conditional-render
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-conditiona.description: Use explicit ternary operators instead of && for conditional rendering. Apply when rendering values that could be 0, NaN, or other falsy values that might render unexpectedly.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-conditiona.descriptionEn: Use explicit ternary operators instead of && for conditional rendering. Apply when rendering values that could be 0, NaN, or other falsy values that might render unexpectedly.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-conditiona.descriptionCn: 使用显式三元运算符而不是 && 进行条件渲染。当呈现可能为 0、NaN 或其他可能意外呈现的虚假值时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-hoist-jsx.title: rendering-hoist-jsx
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-hoist-jsx.description: Extract static JSX elements outside components to avoid re-creation on every render. Apply when rendering static elements repeatedly or in lists.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-hoist-jsx.descriptionEn: Extract static JSX elements outside components to avoid re-creation on every render. Apply when rendering static elements repeatedly or in lists.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rendering-hoist-jsx.descriptionCn: 从组件外部提取静态 JSX 元素，以避免在每次渲染时重新创建。在重复渲染静态元素或在列表中渲染时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-functional-.title: rerender-functional-setstate
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-functional-.description: Use functional setState updates to prevent stale closures and unnecessary callback recreations. Apply when updating state based on the current state value in React components.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-functional-.descriptionEn: Use functional setState updates to prevent stale closures and unnecessary callback recreations. Apply when updating state based on the current state value in React components.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-functional-.descriptionCn: 使用功能性 setState 更新来防止陈旧的闭包和不必要的回调重新创建。当根据 React 组件中的当前状态值更新状态时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-lazy-state.title: rerender-lazy-state
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-lazy-state.description: Use lazy state initialization with useState function form. Apply when computing expensive initial values like building search indexes, parsing JSON, or complex calculations.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-lazy-state.descriptionEn: Use lazy state initialization with useState function form. Apply when computing expensive initial values like building search indexes, parsing JSON, or complex calculations.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-lazy-state.descriptionCn: 通过 useState 函数形式使用惰性状态初始化。在计算昂贵的初始值（例如构建搜索索引、解析 JSON 或复杂计算）时应用。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-memo.title: rerender-memo
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-memo.description: Extract expensive work into memoized components with React.memo. Apply when components perform expensive computations that can be skipped when props haven't changed.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-memo.descriptionEn: Extract expensive work into memoized components with React.memo. Apply when components perform expensive computations that can be skipped when props haven't changed.
theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/rerender-memo.descriptionCn: 使用 React.memo 将昂贵的工作提取到记忆组件中。当组件执行昂贵的计算时应用，当 props 没有改变时可以跳过这些计算。

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/retro-css-architectu.title: retro-css-architecture

theorcdev/8bitcn-ui/retro-css-architectu.descriptionCn: 使用自定义属性、像素字体和响应式像素艺术来组织 8 位 CSS。在创建或修改复古风格的组件及其 CSS 时应用。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/geopan.description: Open source project to make working with geospatial data in python easier. Extends the datatypes used by pandas to allow spatial operations on geometric types. Built on top of Shapely, Fiona, and Pyproj. Use for reading and writing spatial formats (Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, KML), performing spatial joins, coordinate system transformations (reprojecting), geometric analysis (buffers, centroids, convex hulls), thematic mapping (Choropleth maps), calculating spatial relationships (contains, overlaps, touches, within), working with OpenStreetMap data or satellite-derived vector data.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/geopan.descriptionEn: Open source project to make working with geospatial data in python easier. Extends the datatypes used by pandas to allow spatial operations on geometric types. Built on top of Shapely, Fiona, and Pyproj. Use for reading and writing spatial formats (Shapefile, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, KML), performing spatial joins, coordinate system transformations (reprojecting), geometric analysis (buffers, centroids, convex hulls), thematic mapping (Choropleth maps), calculating spatial relationships (contains, overlaps, touches, within), working with OpenStreetMap data or satellite-derived vector data.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/geopan.descriptionCn: 开源项目，使在 python 中处理地理空间数据变得更容易。扩展 pandas 使用的数据类型以允许对几何类型进行空间操作。构建于 Shapely、Fiona 和 Pyproj 之上。用于读取和写入空间格式（Shapefile、GeoJSON、GeoPackage、KML）、执行空间连接、坐标系转换（重新投影）、几何分析（缓冲区、质心、凸包）、专题制图（等值线图）、计算空间关系（包含、重叠、接触、内部）、使用 OpenStreetMap 数据或卫星衍生的矢量数据。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/jax.title: jax
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/jax.description: Composable transformations of Python+NumPy programs. Differentiate, vectorize, JIT-compile to GPU/TPU. Built for high-performance machine learning research and complex scientific simulations. Use for automatic differentiation, GPU/TPU acceleration, higher-order derivatives, physics-informed machine learning, differentiable simulations, and automatic vectorization.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/jax.descriptionEn: Composable transformations of Python+NumPy programs. Differentiate, vectorize, JIT-compile to GPU/TPU. Built for high-performance machine learning research and complex scientific simulations. Use for automatic differentiation, GPU/TPU acceleration, higher-order derivatives, physics-informed machine learning, differentiable simulations, and automatic vectorization.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/jax.descriptionCn: Python+NumPy 程序的可组合转换。微分、矢量化、JIT 编译到 GPU/TPU。专为高性能机器学习研究和复杂的科学模拟而构建。用于自动微分、GPU/TPU 加速、高阶导数、物理信息机器学习、可微分模拟和自动矢量化。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/jax-pd.title: jax-pde
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/jax-pd.description: Advanced sub-skill for JAX focused on solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) and Differentiable Physics. Covers Finite Difference Methods (FDM), Neural Operators, and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/jax-pd.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for JAX focused on solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) and Differentiable Physics. Covers Finite Difference Methods (FDM), Neural Operators, and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/jax-pd.descriptionCn: JAX 的高级子技能专注于求解偏微分方程 (PDE) 和可微物理。涵盖有限差分法 (FDM)、神经算子和物理信息神经网络 (PINN)。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/matplo.title: matplotlib
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/matplo.description: The foundational library for creating static, animated, and interactive visualizations in Python. Highly customizable and the industry standard for publication-quality figures. Use for 2D plotting, scientific data visualization, heatmaps, contours, vector fields, multi-panel figures, LaTeX-formatted plots, custom visualization tools, and plotting from NumPy arrays or Pandas DataFrames.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/matplo.descriptionEn: The foundational library for creating static, animated, and interactive visualizations in Python. Highly customizable and the industry standard for publication-quality figures. Use for 2D plotting, scientific data visualization, heatmaps, contours, vector fields, multi-panel figures, LaTeX-formatted plots, custom visualization tools, and plotting from NumPy arrays or Pandas DataFrames.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/matplo.descriptionCn: 用于在 Python 中创建静态、动画和交互式可视化的基础库。高度可定制和出版质量数据的行业标准。用于 2D 绘图、科学数据可视化、热图、轮廓、矢量场、多面板图形、LaTeX 格式的绘图、自定义可视化工具以及从 NumPy 数组或 Pandas DataFrame 进行绘图。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/matplo.title: matplotlib-pro
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/matplo.description: Professional sub-skill for Matplotlib focused on high-performance animations, complex multi-figure layouts (GridSpec), interactive widgets, and publication-ready typography (LaTeX/PGF).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/matplo.descriptionEn: Professional sub-skill for Matplotlib focused on high-performance animations, complex multi-figure layouts (GridSpec), interactive widgets, and publication-ready typography (LaTeX/PGF).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/matplo.descriptionCn: Matplotlib 的专业子技能专注于高性能动画、复杂的多图形布局 (GridSpec)、交互式小部件和可发布的版式 (LaTeX/PGF)。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mdanal.title: mdanalysis
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mdanal.description: Comprehensive guide for MDAnalysis - the Python library for analyzing molecular dynamics trajectories. Use for trajectory loading, RMSD/RMSF calculations, distance/angle/dihedral analysis, atom selections, hydrogen bonds, solvent accessible surface area, protein structure analysis, membrane analysis, and integration with Biopython. Essential for MD simulation analysis.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mdanal.descriptionEn: Comprehensive guide for MDAnalysis - the Python library for analyzing molecular dynamics trajectories. Use for trajectory loading, RMSD/RMSF calculations, distance/angle/dihedral analysis, atom selections, hydrogen bonds, solvent accessible surface area, protein structure analysis, membrane analysis, and integration with Biopython. Essential for MD simulation analysis.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mdanal.descriptionCn: MDAnalysis 的综合指南 - 用于分析分子动力学轨迹的 Python 库。用于轨迹加载、RMSD/RMSF 计算、距离/角度/二面角分析、原子选择、氢键、溶剂可及表面积、蛋白质结构分析、膜分析以及与 Biopython 集成。 MD 模拟分析必不可少。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mne.title: mne
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mne.description: Open-source Python package for exploring, visualizing, and analyzing human neurophysiological data including EEG, MEG, sEEG, and ECoG.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mne.descriptionEn: Open-source Python package for exploring, visualizing, and analyzing human neurophysiological data including EEG, MEG, sEEG, and ECoG.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/mne.descriptionCn: 用于探索、可视化和分析人类神经生理学数据（包括 EEG、MEG、sEEG 和 ECoG）的开源 Python 包。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/networ.title: networkx
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/networ.description: Python package for the creation, manipulation, and study of the structure, dynamics, and functions of complex networks. Supports various graph types (Directed, Undirected, Multigraphs) and features a vast library of standard graph algorithms. Use for network analysis, graph theory, social network analysis, biological networks, infrastructure networks, path finding, centrality measures, community detection, graph algorithms, shortest paths, PageRank, connectivity analysis, and routing optimization.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/networ.descriptionEn: Python package for the creation, manipulation, and study of the structure, dynamics, and functions of complex networks. Supports various graph types (Directed, Undirected, Multigraphs) and features a vast library of standard graph algorithms. Use for network analysis, graph theory, social network analysis, biological networks, infrastructure networks, path finding, centrality measures, community detection, graph algorithms, shortest paths, PageRank, connectivity analysis, and routing optimization.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/networ.descriptionCn: 用于创建、操作和研究复杂网络的结构、动力学和功能的 Python 包。支持各种图类型（有向图、无向图、多重图），并具有庞大的标准图算法库。用于网络分析、图论、社交网络分析、生物网络、基础设施网络、路径查找、中心性度量、社区检测、图算法、最短路径、PageRank、连接性分析和路由优化。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numba.title: numba
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numba.description: A Just-In-Time (JIT) compiler for Python that translates a subset of Python and NumPy code into fast machine code. Developed by Anaconda, Inc. Highly effective for accelerating loops, custom mathematical functions, and complex numerical algorithms. Use for @njit, @vectorize, prange, cuda.jit, numba.typed, JIT compilation, parallel loops, GPU acceleration with CUDA, Monte Carlo simulations, numerical algorithms, and high-performance Python computing.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numba.descriptionEn: A Just-In-Time (JIT) compiler for Python that translates a subset of Python and NumPy code into fast machine code. Developed by Anaconda, Inc. Highly effective for accelerating loops, custom mathematical functions, and complex numerical algorithms. Use for @njit, @vectorize, prange, cuda.jit, numba.typed, JIT compilation, parallel loops, GPU acceleration with CUDA, Monte Carlo simulations, numerical algorithms, and high-performance Python computing.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numba.descriptionCn: Python 的即时 (JIT) 编译器，可将 Python 和 NumPy 代码的子集转换为快速机器代码。由 Anaconda, Inc. 开发。对于加速循环、自定义数学函数和复杂的数值算法非常有效。用于@njit、@vectorize、prange、cuda.jit、numba.typed、JIT 编译、并行循环、CUDA 的 GPU 加速、蒙特卡罗模拟、数值算法和高性能 Python 计算。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy.title: numpy
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy.description: Comprehensive guide for NumPy - the fundamental package for scientific computing in Python. Use for array operations, linear algebra, random number generation, Fourier transforms, mathematical functions, and high-performance numerical computing. Foundation for SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and all scientific Python.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy.descriptionEn: Comprehensive guide for NumPy - the fundamental package for scientific computing in Python. Use for array operations, linear algebra, random number generation, Fourier transforms, mathematical functions, and high-performance numerical computing. Foundation for SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and all scientific Python.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy.descriptionCn: NumPy 综合指南 - Python 中科学计算的基础包。用于数组运算、线性代数、随机数生成、傅里叶变换、数学函数和高性能数值计算。 SciPy、pandas、scikit-learn 和所有科学 Python 的基础。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy-.title: numpy-low-level
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy-.description: Advanced sub-skill for NumPy focused on internal memory management, stride manipulation, structured arrays, and interfacing with C/Cython. Covers zero-copy operations and SIMD vectorization principles.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy-.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for NumPy focused on internal memory management, stride manipulation, structured arrays, and interfacing with C/Cython. Covers zero-copy operations and SIMD vectorization principles.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/numpy-.descriptionCn: NumPy 的高级子技能侧重于内部内存管理、跨步操作、结构化数组以及与 C/Cython 的接口。涵盖零拷贝操作和 SIMD 矢量化原理。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/openba.title: openbabel
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/openba.description: A chemical toolbox designed to speak the many languages of chemical data. Supports over 110 formats and provides tools for conversion, 3D structure generation, molecular searching (SMARTS), and force field calculations. Use for chemical file format conversion (SDF, PDB, SMILES, CIF, Gaussian), 3D coordinate generation from 2D structures, substructure searching with SMARTS patterns, molecular docking preparation, force field minimizations (UFF, GAFF, MMFF94), molecular fingerprints and Tanimoto coefficients, and batch processing of chemical databases.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/openba.descriptionEn: A chemical toolbox designed to speak the many languages of chemical data. Supports over 110 formats and provides tools for conversion, 3D structure generation, molecular searching (SMARTS), and force field calculations. Use for chemical file format conversion (SDF, PDB, SMILES, CIF, Gaussian), 3D coordinate generation from 2D structures, substructure searching with SMARTS patterns, molecular docking preparation, force field minimizations (UFF, GAFF, MMFF94), molecular fingerprints and Tanimoto coefficients, and batch processing of chemical databases.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/openba.descriptionCn: 一个化学工具箱，旨在使用多种化学数据语言。支持 110 多种格式，并提供转换、3D 结构生成、分子搜索 (SMARTS) 和力场计算工具。用于化学文件格式转换（SDF、PDB、SMILES、CIF、高斯）、从 2D 结构生成 3D 坐标、使用 SMARTS 模式搜索子结构、分子对接准备、力场最小化（UFF、GAFF、MMFF94）、分子指纹和 Tanimoto 系数以及化学数据库的批量处理。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/opencv.title: opencv
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/opencv.description: Open Source Computer Vision Library (OpenCV) for real-time image processing, video analysis, object detection, face recognition, and camera calibration. Use when working with images, videos, cameras, edge detection, contours, feature detection, image transformations, object tracking, optical flow, or any computer vision task.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/opencv.descriptionEn: Open Source Computer Vision Library (OpenCV) for real-time image processing, video analysis, object detection, face recognition, and camera calibration. Use when working with images, videos, cameras, edge detection, contours, feature detection, image transformations, object tracking, optical flow, or any computer vision task.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/opencv.descriptionCn: 开源计算机视觉库 (OpenCV)，用于实时图像处理、视频分析、对象检测、人脸识别和相机校准。在处理图像、视频、相机、边缘检测、轮廓、特征检测、图像转换、对象跟踪、光流或任何计算机视觉任务时使用。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/ortool.title: ortools
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/ortool.description: Google Optimization Tools. An open-source software suite for optimization, specialized in vehicle routing, flows, integer and linear programming, and constraint programming. Features the world-class CP-SAT solver. Use for vehicle routing problems (VRP), scheduling, bin packing, knapsack problems, linear programming (LP), integer programming (MIP), network flows, constraint programming, combinatorial optimization, resource allocation, shift scheduling, job-shop scheduling, and discrete optimization problems.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/ortool.descriptionEn: Google Optimization Tools. An open-source software suite for optimization, specialized in vehicle routing, flows, integer and linear programming, and constraint programming. Features the world-class CP-SAT solver. Use for vehicle routing problems (VRP), scheduling, bin packing, knapsack problems, linear programming (LP), integer programming (MIP), network flows, constraint programming, combinatorial optimization, resource allocation, shift scheduling, job-shop scheduling, and discrete optimization problems.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/ortool.descriptionCn: 谷歌优化工具。用于优化的开源软件套件，专门用于车辆路径、流程、整数和线性规划以及约束规划。具有世界一流的 CP-SAT 求解器。用于车辆路径问题 (VRP)、调度、装箱、背包问题、线性规划 (LP)、整数规划 (MIP)、网络流、约束规划、组合优化、资源分配、班次调度、作业车间调度和离散优化问题。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pandas.title: pandas-performance
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pandas.description: Advanced sub-skill for pandas focused on memory optimization, execution speed, and handling large-scale datasets (10M+ rows). Covers low-level dtypes, efficient indexing, and vectorization of complex logic.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pandas.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for pandas focused on memory optimization, execution speed, and handling large-scale datasets (10M+ rows). Covers low-level dtypes, efficient indexing, and vectorization of complex logic.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pandas.descriptionCn: pandas 的高级子技能专注于内存优化、执行速度和处理大规模数据集（10M+ 行）。涵盖低级数据类型、高效索引和复杂逻辑的矢量化。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/plotly.title: plotly
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/plotly.description: A high-level interactive graphing library for Python. Ideal for web-based visualizations, 3D plots, and complex interactive dashboards. Built on plotly.js, it allows users to zoom, pan, and hover over data points in a browser-based environment. Use for interactive charts, web applications, Jupyter notebooks, 3D data visualization, geographic maps, financial charts, animations, time-series analysis, and building production-ready dashboards with Dash.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/plotly.descriptionEn: A high-level interactive graphing library for Python. Ideal for web-based visualizations, 3D plots, and complex interactive dashboards. Built on plotly.js, it allows users to zoom, pan, and hover over data points in a browser-based environment. Use for interactive charts, web applications, Jupyter notebooks, 3D data visualization, geographic maps, financial charts, animations, time-series analysis, and building production-ready dashboards with Dash.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/plotly.descriptionCn: Python 的高级交互式图形库。非常适合基于 Web 的可视化、3D 绘图和复杂的交互式仪表板。它基于plotly.js 构建，允许用户在基于浏览器的环境中缩放、平移和悬停在数据点上。用于交互式图表、Web 应用程序、Jupyter 笔记本、3D 数据可视化、地理地图、财务图表、动画、时间序列分析以及使用 Dash 构建生产就绪的仪表板。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/polars.title: polars
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/polars.description: Blazingly fast DataFrame library written in Rust. Features a multi-threaded query engine, lazy evaluation, and efficient memory usage via Apache Arrow. Designed for high-performance data processing on a single machine. Use for large datasets (1GB-100GB+), fast data transformations, Parquet/CSV processing, complex query pipelines, memory-efficient operations, and when speed is critical (10-100x faster than pandas).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/polars.descriptionEn: Blazingly fast DataFrame library written in Rust. Features a multi-threaded query engine, lazy evaluation, and efficient memory usage via Apache Arrow. Designed for high-performance data processing on a single machine. Use for large datasets (1GB-100GB+), fast data transformations, Parquet/CSV processing, complex query pipelines, memory-efficient operations, and when speed is critical (10-100x faster than pandas).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/polars.descriptionCn: 用 Rust 编写的速度极快的 DataFrame 库。具有多线程查询引擎、惰性求值以及通过 Apache Arrow 实现的高效内存使用。专为在单台机器上进行高性能数据处理而设计。用于大型数据集 (1GB-100GB+)、快速数据转换、Parquet/CSV 处理、复杂查询管道、内存高效操作以及速度至关重要的情况（比 pandas 快 10-100 倍）。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/prody.title: prody
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/prody.description: Protein Dynamics, Evolution, and Structure analysis. Specialized in Normal Mode Analysis (NMA) using Anisotropic (ANM) and Gaussian Network Models (GNM). Features tools for structural ensemble analysis, PCA, and co-evolutionary analysis (Evol). Use for protein flexibility prediction, collective motions, structural ensemble comparison, hinge region identification, binding site analysis, MD trajectory filtering, and evolutionary analysis.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/prody.descriptionEn: Protein Dynamics, Evolution, and Structure analysis. Specialized in Normal Mode Analysis (NMA) using Anisotropic (ANM) and Gaussian Network Models (GNM). Features tools for structural ensemble analysis, PCA, and co-evolutionary analysis (Evol). Use for protein flexibility prediction, collective motions, structural ensemble comparison, hinge region identification, binding site analysis, MD trajectory filtering, and evolutionary analysis.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/prody.descriptionCn: 蛋白质动力学、进化和结构分析。专门从事使用各向异性 (ANM) 和高斯网络模型 (GNM) 的正则模态分析 (NMA)。具有用于结构集成分析、PCA 和协同进化分析 (Evol) 的工具。用于蛋白质灵活性预测、集体运动、结构整体比较、铰链区识别、结合位点分析、MD 轨迹过滤和进化分析。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyomo.title: pyomo
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyomo.description: Python Optimization Modeling Objects. A high-level framework for formulating, solving, and analyzing optimization models. Supports Linear Programming (LP), Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), and Non-Linear Programming (NLP). Part of the COIN-OR project. Use for mathematical optimization, linear programming, mixed-integer programming, non-linear programming, strategic planning, process engineering, energy systems, supply chain optimization, stochastic programming, and solver integration with IPOPT, SCIP, Gurobi, CPLEX, or GLPK.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyomo.descriptionEn: Python Optimization Modeling Objects. A high-level framework for formulating, solving, and analyzing optimization models. Supports Linear Programming (LP), Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP), and Non-Linear Programming (NLP). Part of the COIN-OR project. Use for mathematical optimization, linear programming, mixed-integer programming, non-linear programming, strategic planning, process engineering, energy systems, supply chain optimization, stochastic programming, and solver integration with IPOPT, SCIP, Gurobi, CPLEX, or GLPK.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyomo.descriptionCn: Python 优化建模对象。用于制定、求解和分析优化模型的高级框架。支持线性规划 (LP)、混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 和非线性规划 (NLP)。 COIN-OR 项目的一部分。用于数学优化、线性规划、混合整数规划、非线性规划、战略规划、流程工程、能源系统、供应链优化、随机规划以及与 IPOPT、SCIP、Gurobi、CPLEX 或 GLPK 的求解器集成。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyproj.title: pyproj
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyproj.description: Python interface to PROJ (cartographic projections and coordinate transformations library). Handles transformations between different Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS) and performs geodetic calculations (distance, area on ellipsoids). Use for coordinate transformations, CRS conversions, geodetic calculations, UTM projections, GPS coordinate conversions, ellipsoidal distance calculations, and spatial reference system operations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyproj.descriptionEn: Python interface to PROJ (cartographic projections and coordinate transformations library). Handles transformations between different Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS) and performs geodetic calculations (distance, area on ellipsoids). Use for coordinate transformations, CRS conversions, geodetic calculations, UTM projections, GPS coordinate conversions, ellipsoidal distance calculations, and spatial reference system operations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyproj.descriptionCn: PROJ（制图投影和坐标转换库）的 Python 接口。处理不同坐标参考系 (CRS) 之间的转换并执行大地测量计算（椭圆体上的距离、面积）。用于坐标变换、CRS 转换、大地测量计算、UTM 投影、GPS 坐标转换、椭球距离计算和空间参考系统操作。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyscf.title: pyscf
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyscf.description: Comprehensive guide for PySCF - Python-based Simulations of Chemistry Framework. Use for ab initio quantum chemistry calculations including Hartree-Fock, DFT, MP2, CCSD, geometry optimization, excited states, and molecular properties. Industry-standard library for electronic structure calculations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyscf.descriptionEn: Comprehensive guide for PySCF - Python-based Simulations of Chemistry Framework. Use for ab initio quantum chemistry calculations including Hartree-Fock, DFT, MP2, CCSD, geometry optimization, excited states, and molecular properties. Industry-standard library for electronic structure calculations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pyscf.descriptionCn: PySCF 综合指南 - 基于 Python 的化学模拟框架。用于从头算量子化学计算，包括 Hartree-Fock、DFT、MP2、CCSD、几何优化、激发态和分子特性。用于电子结构计算的行业标准库。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.title: pytorch
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.description: Leading deep learning framework. Provides Tensors and Dynamic Computational Graphs with strong GPU acceleration. Widely used for research, neural networks, and differentiable programming.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionEn: Leading deep learning framework. Provides Tensors and Dynamic Computational Graphs with strong GPU acceleration. Widely used for research, neural networks, and differentiable programming.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionCn: 领先的深度学习框架。提供具有强大GPU加速的张量和动态计算图。广泛用于研究、神经网络和可微分编程。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.title: pytorch-deployment
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.description: Advanced sub-skill for PyTorch focused on model productionization and deployment. Covers TorchScript (JIT/Tracing), ONNX export, LibTorch (C++ API), and inference optimization (Quantization, Pruning).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for PyTorch focused on model productionization and deployment. Covers TorchScript (JIT/Tracing), ONNX export, LibTorch (C++ API), and inference optimization (Quantization, Pruning).

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.title: pytorch-research
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.description: Advanced sub-skill for PyTorch focused on deep research and production engineering. Covers custom Autograd functions, module hooks, advanced initialization, Distributed Data Parallel (DDP), and performance profiling.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/pytorc.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for PyTorch focused on deep research and production engineering. Covers custom Autograd functions, module hooks, advanced initialization, Distributed Data Parallel (DDP), and performance profiling.

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/qiskit.title: qiskit-hardware
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/qiskit.description: Advanced sub-skill for Qiskit focused on executing circuits on physical quantum processing units (QPUs). Covers IBM Quantum Runtime, error mitigation techniques (TREX, ZNE), hardware-aware transpilation, and low-level pulse control (OpenPulse).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/qiskit.descriptionEn: Advanced sub-skill for Qiskit focused on executing circuits on physical quantum processing units (QPUs). Covers IBM Quantum Runtime, error mitigation techniques (TREX, ZNE), hardware-aware transpilation, and low-level pulse control (OpenPulse).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/qiskit.descriptionCn: Qiskit 的高级子技能专注于在物理量子处理单元 (QPU) 上执行电路。涵盖 IBM Quantum Runtime、错误缓解技术（TREX、ZNE）、硬件感知转译和低​​级脉冲控制 (OpenPulse)。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.title: scikit-image
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.description: A collection of algorithms for image processing in Python. Built on NumPy, SciPy, and Cython. It focuses on scientific image analysis including segmentation, geometric transformations, color space manipulation, analysis, and filtering.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionEn: A collection of algorithms for image processing in Python. Built on NumPy, SciPy, and Cython. It focuses on scientific image analysis including segmentation, geometric transformations, color space manipulation, analysis, and filtering.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionCn: Python 中图像处理算法的集合。基于 NumPy、SciPy 和 Cython 构建。它专注于科学图像分析，包括分割、几何变换、色彩空间操作、分析和过滤。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.title: scikit-video
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.description: Video processing library for scientists. Provides easy access to video files using FFmpeg, motion estimation algorithms, and video quality metrics. Built on NumPy and designed for high-performance research in computer vision and image sequence analysis. Use when working with video files, motion estimation, video quality assessment (VQA), FFmpeg, temporal image data, video codecs, YUV data, or scientific video recordings.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionEn: Video processing library for scientists. Provides easy access to video files using FFmpeg, motion estimation algorithms, and video quality metrics. Built on NumPy and designed for high-performance research in computer vision and image sequence analysis. Use when working with video files, motion estimation, video quality assessment (VQA), FFmpeg, temporal image data, video codecs, YUV data, or scientific video recordings.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scikit.descriptionCn: 为科学家提供的视频处理库。使用 FFmpeg、运动估计算法和视频质量指标轻松访问视频文件。基于 NumPy 构建，专为计算机视觉和图像序列分析的高性能研究而设计。在处理视频文件、运动估计、视频质量评估 (VQA)、FFmpeg、时态图像数据、视频编解码器、YUV 数据或科学视频录制时使用。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scipy.title: scipy
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scipy.description: Comprehensive guide for SciPy - the fundamental library for scientific and technical computing in Python. Use for integration, optimization, interpolation, linear algebra, signal processing, statistics, ODEs, Fourier transforms, and advanced scientific algorithms. Built on NumPy and essential for research and engineering.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scipy.descriptionEn: Comprehensive guide for SciPy - the fundamental library for scientific and technical computing in Python. Use for integration, optimization, interpolation, linear algebra, signal processing, statistics, ODEs, Fourier transforms, and advanced scientific algorithms. Built on NumPy and essential for research and engineering.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/scipy.descriptionCn: SciPy 综合指南 - Python 中科学和技术计算的基础库。用于积分、优化、插值、线性代数、信号处理、统计、ODE、傅立叶变换和高级科学算法。基于 NumPy 构建，对于研究和工程至关重要。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/seabor.title: seaborn
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/seabor.description: A Python data visualization library based on matplotlib. It provides a high-level interface for drawing attractive and informative statistical graphics. Great for exploring relationships between variables and visualizing distributions. Use for statistical data visualization, exploratory data analysis (EDA), relationship plots, distribution plots, categorical comparisons, regression visualization, heatmaps, cluster maps, and creating publication-quality statistical graphics from Pandas DataFrames.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/seabor.descriptionEn: A Python data visualization library based on matplotlib. It provides a high-level interface for drawing attractive and informative statistical graphics. Great for exploring relationships between variables and visualizing distributions. Use for statistical data visualization, exploratory data analysis (EDA), relationship plots, distribution plots, categorical comparisons, regression visualization, heatmaps, cluster maps, and creating publication-quality statistical graphics from Pandas DataFrames.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/seabor.descriptionCn: 一个基于matplotlib的Python数据可视化库。它提供了一个高级界面，用于绘制有吸引力且信息丰富的统计图形。非常适合探索变量之间的关系和可视化分布。用于统计数据可视化、探索性数据分析 (EDA)、关系图、分布图、分类比较、回归可视化、热图、聚类图以及从 Pandas DataFrames 创建出版质量的统计图形。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/shapel.title: shapely
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/shapel.description: Manipulation and analysis of planar geometric objects. Based on the widely deployed GEOS library. Provides data structures for points, curves, and surfaces, and standardized algorithms for geometric operations. Use for 2D geometry operations, spatial relationships, set-theoretic operations (intersection, union, difference), point-in-polygon queries, geometric calculations (area, distance, centroid), buffering, simplifying geometries, linear referencing, and cleaning invalid geometries. Essential for GIS operations, spatial analysis, and geometric computations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/shapel.descriptionEn: Manipulation and analysis of planar geometric objects. Based on the widely deployed GEOS library. Provides data structures for points, curves, and surfaces, and standardized algorithms for geometric operations. Use for 2D geometry operations, spatial relationships, set-theoretic operations (intersection, union, difference), point-in-polygon queries, geometric calculations (area, distance, centroid), buffering, simplifying geometries, linear referencing, and cleaning invalid geometries. Essential for GIS operations, spatial analysis, and geometric computations.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/shapel.descriptionCn: 平面几何对象的操作和分析。基于广泛部署的 GEOS 库。提供点、曲线、曲面的数据结构以及几何运算的标准化算法。用于 2D 几何操作、空间关系、集合论操作（交、并、差）、多边形内点查询、几何计算（面积、距离、质心）、缓冲、简化几何、线性参考和清理无效几何。对于 GIS 操作、空间分析和几何计算至关重要。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sklear.title: sklearn-advanced

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sklear.descriptionEn: Professional sub-skill for scikit-learn focused on robust pipeline architecture, custom estimator development, advanced feature engineering, and rigorous model validation. tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sklear.title: sklearn-explainability
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sklear.description: Advanced sub-skill for scikit-learn focused on model interpretability, feature importance, and diagnostic tools. Covers global and local explanations using built-in inspection tools and SHAP/LIME integrations.

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sklear.descriptionCn: scikit-learn 的高级子技能专注于模型可解释性、特征重要性和诊断工具。涵盖使用内置检查工具和 SHAP/LIME 集成的全球和本地解释。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/statsm.title: statsmodels
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/statsm.description: Advanced statistical modeling and hypothesis testing. Complementary to SciPy's stats module, it provides classes and functions for the estimation of many different statistical models, as well as for conducting statistical tests and statistical data exploration. Use for linear regression, GLM, time series analysis, ANOVA, survival analysis, causal inference, and statistical hypothesis testing. Load when working with OLS, WLS, logistic regression, Poisson regression, ARIMA, SARIMAX, statistical diagnostics, p-values, confidence intervals, or R-style statistical analysis.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/statsm.descriptionEn: Advanced statistical modeling and hypothesis testing. tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/statsm.descriptionCn: 高级统计建模和假设检验。作为 SciPy 统计模块的补充，它提供了用于估计许多不同统计模型以及进行统计测试和统计数据探索的类和函数。用于线性回归、GLM、时间序列分析、方差分析、生存分析、因果推断和统计假设检验。使用 OLS、WLS、逻辑回归、泊松回归、ARIMA、SARIMAX、统计诊断、p 值、置信区间或 R 型统计分析时加载。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sunpy.title: sunpy
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sunpy.description: The community-developed free and open-source software package for solar physics. Provides tools for data search and download, coordinate transformations specific to solar physics, and powerful image processing through the Map object. Use when working with solar data, solar images (EUV, magnetograms, white light), solar coordinates (Helioprojective, Heliographic), Fido data search, solar time series, differential rotation, limb fitting, or multi-instrument solar analysis (AIA, HMI, GOES).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sunpy.descriptionEn: The community-developed free and open-source software package for solar physics. Provides tools for data search and download, coordinate transformations specific to solar physics, and powerful image processing through the Map object. Use when working with solar data, solar images (EUV, magnetograms, white light), solar coordinates (Helioprojective, Heliographic), Fido data search, solar time series, differential rotation, limb fitting, or multi-instrument solar analysis (AIA, HMI, GOES).
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sunpy.descriptionCn: 社区开发的免费开源太阳物理学软件包。提供数据搜索和下载工具、特定于太阳物理的坐标转换以及通过 Map 对象进行强大的图像处理。在处理太阳数据、太阳图像（EUV、磁图、白光）、太阳坐标（日射、日照）、FIDO 数据搜索、太阳时间序列、差分旋转、肢体拟合或多仪器太阳分析（AIA、HMI、GOES）时使用。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sympy.title: sympy
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sympy.description: Comprehensive guide for SymPy - Python library for symbolic mathematics. Use for symbolic expressions, calculus (derivatives, integrals, limits, series), equation solving (algebraic, differential, systems), linear algebra, simplification, matrix operations, special functions, code generation, and mathematical proofs. Essential for analytical mathematics and computer algebra.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sympy.descriptionEn: Comprehensive guide for SymPy - Python library for symbolic mathematics. Use for symbolic expressions, calculus (derivatives, integrals, limits, series), equation solving (algebraic, differential, systems), linear algebra, simplification, matrix operations, special functions, code generation, and mathematical proofs. Essential for analytical mathematics and computer algebra.
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/sympy.descriptionCn: SymPy 综合指南 - 用于符号数学的 Python 库。用于符号表达式、微积分（导数、积分、极限、级数）、方程求解（代数、微分、系统）、线性代数、简化、矩阵运算、特殊函数、代码生成和数学证明。分析数学和计算机代数必备。

tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/tqdm.title: tqdm
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/tqdm.description: A fast, extensible progress bar for Python and CLI. tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/xarray.title: xarray
tondevrel/scientific-agent-skills/xarray.description: N-dimensional labeled arrays and datasets in Python. Built on top of NumPy and Dask. Use for working with multi-dimensional scientific data, NetCDF/GRIB/Zarr files, climate/weather/oceanographic datasets, remote sensing, geospatial imaging, large out-of-memory datasets with Dask, and labeled array operations.

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/data-q.title: data-quality-checker

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/divide.title: dividend-growth-pullback-screener
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/divide.description: Use this skill to find high-quality dividend growth stocks (12%+ annual dividend growth, 1.5%+ yield) that are experiencing temporary pullbacks, identified by RSI oversold conditions (RSI ≤40). tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/dual-a.title: dual-axis-skill-reviewer
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/dual-a.description: Review skills in any project using a dual-axis method: (1) deterministic code-based checks (structure, scripts, tests, execution safety) and (2) LLM deep review findings. Use when you need reproducible quality scoring for `skills/*/SKILL.md`, want to gate merges with a score threshold (for example 90+), or need concrete improvement items for low-scoring skills. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.title: earnings-calendar
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.description: This skill retrieves upcoming earnings announcements for US stocks using the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API. Use this when the user requests earnings calendar data, wants to know which companies are reporting earnings in the upcoming week, or needs a weekly earnings review. The skill focuses on mid-cap and above companies (over $2B market cap) that have significant market impact, organizing the data by date and timing in a clean markdown table format. Supports multiple environments (CLI, Desktop, Web) with flexible API key management.

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.descriptionCn: 此技能使用 Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API 检索即将发布的美国股票收益公告。当用户请求收益日历数据、想要了解哪些公司将在下周报告收益或需要每周收益审核时，请使用此选项。该技能侧重于具有重大市场影响的中型及以上公司（市值超过 20 亿美元），以干净的降价表格式按日期和时间组织数据。通过灵活的 API 密钥管理支持多种环境（CLI、桌面、Web）。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.title: earnings-trade-analyzer
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.description: Analyze recent post-earnings stocks using a 5-factor scoring system (Gap Size, Pre-Earnings Trend, Volume Trend, MA200 Position, MA50 Position). tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/earnin.descriptionCn: 使用 5 因素评分系统（差距大小、盈利前趋势、交易量趋势、MA200 头寸、MA50 头寸）分析近期盈利后股票。对每只股票进行 0-100 分评分并分配 A/B/C/D 等级。当用户询问收益交易分析、收益后动量筛选、收益差距评分或查找近期最佳收益反应时使用。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/exposu.title: exposure-coach

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.title: market-news-analyst
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/market.description: This skill should be used when analyzing recent market-moving news events and their impact on equity markets and commodities. Use this skill when the user requests analysis of major financial news from the past 10 days, wants to understand market reactions to monetary policy decisions (FOMC, ECB, BOJ), needs assessment of geopolitical events' impact on commodities, or requires comprehensive review of earnings announcements from mega-cap stocks. Generates a 0-100 composite score with risk zone classification. Use when user requests options strategy analysis, covered calls, protective puts, spreads, iron condors, earnings plays, or options risk management. Includes volatility analysis, position sizing, and earnings-based strategy recommendations. Educational focus with practical trade simulation.

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/pead-s.title: pead-screener

scenario-analystエージェントで主分析を実行し、
strategy-reviewerエージェントでセカンドオピニオンを取得。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/stanle.descriptionCn: 根据斯坦利·德鲁肯米勒的投资理念和策略提供投资建议。借鉴30年不败、年回报率近30%的传奇投资者的思维方式，为宏观经济分析、风险管理、仓位调整和解读市场周期提供实用指导。在寻求有关投资决策、市场分析、风险控制和投资组合构建的建议时使用。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/strate.description: Detect backtest iteration stagnation and generate structurally different strategy pivot proposals when parameter tuning reaches a local optimum.

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/techni.description: This skill should be used when analyzing weekly price charts for stocks, stock indices, cryptocurrencies, or forex pairs. Use this skill when the user provides chart images and requests technical analysis, trend identification, support/resistance levels, scenario planning, or probability assessments based purely on chart data without consideration of news or fundamental factors.

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/techni.descriptionCn: 在分析股票、股指、加密货币或外汇对的每周价格图表时应使用此技能。当用户提供图表图像并请求技术分析、趋势识别、支撑/阻力水平、情景规划或纯粹基于图表数据而不考虑新闻或基本面因素的概率评估时，请使用此技能。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/theme-.title: theme-detector
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/theme-.description: Detect and analyze trending market themes across sectors. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/trader.title: trader-memory-core

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/trader.descriptionCn: 跟踪投资论文的整个生命周期——从筛选创意到通过事后分析结清头寸。从筛选器输出中注册论文、管理状态转换、附加头寸规模、审查截止日期并通过损益和 MAE/MFE 分析生成事后分析报告。当用户说“注册论文”、“跟踪这个想法”、“论文状态”、“到期审查”、“平仓”、“事后分析”或“交易日志”时触发。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/uptren.title: uptrend-analyzer
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/uptren.description: Analyzes market breadth using Monty's Uptrend Ratio Dashboard data to diagnose the current market environment. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/uptren.descriptionEn: Analyzes market breadth using Monty's Uptrend Ratio Dashboard data to diagnose the current market environment. tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/uptren.descriptionCn: 使用 Monty 的上升趋势比率仪表板数据分析市场广度，以诊断当前的市场环境。从 5 个组成部分（广度、行业参与度、轮动、势头、历史背景）生成 0-100 分的综合得分。在询问市场广度、上升趋势比率或市场环境是否支持股票敞口时使用。无需 API 密钥。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/us-mar.title: us-market-bubble-detector
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/us-mar.description: Evaluates market bubble risk through quantitative data-driven analysis using the revised Minsky/Kindleberger framework v2.1. Prioritizes objective metrics (Put/Call, VIX, margin debt, breadth, IPO data) over subjective impressions. Features strict qualitative adjustment criteria with confirmation bias prevention. Supports practical investment decisions with mandatory data collection and mechanical scoring. Use when user asks about bubble risk, valuation concerns, or profit-taking timing.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/us-mar.descriptionEn: Evaluates market bubble risk through quantitative data-driven analysis using the revised Minsky/Kindleberger framework v2.1. Supports practical investment decisions with mandatory data collection and mechanical scoring. Use when user asks about bubble risk, valuation concerns, or profit-taking timing.
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/us-mar.descriptionCn: 使用修订后的 Minsky/Kindleberger 框架 v2.1 通过定量数据驱动分析来评估市场泡沫风险。优先考虑客观指标（看跌/看涨期权、VIX、保证金债务、广度、IPO 数据）而不是主观印象。具有严格的定性调整标准和预防确认偏差的特点。通过强制数据收集和机械评分支持实际投资决策。当用户询问泡沫风险、估值担忧或获利了结时机时使用。

Use when user requests analysis of US stock tickers (e.g., "analyze AAPL", "compare TSLA vs NVDA", "give me a report on Microsoft"), evaluation of financial metrics, technical chart analysis, or investment recommendations for American stocks.

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/value-.title: value-dividend-screener
tradermonty/claude-trading-skills/value-.description: Screen US stocks for high-quality dividend opportunities combining value characteristics (P/E ratio under 20, P/B ratio under 2), attractive yields (3% or higher), and consistent growth (dividend/revenue/EPS trending up over 3 years). Use when user requests dividend stock screening, income portfolio ideas, or quality value stocks with strong fundamentals.
