trevors/dot-claude/using-jj.title: using-jj
trevors/dot-claude/using-jj.description: Use this skill for ANY task involving jj or jujutsu version control. ALWAYS trigger when the user mentions jj, jujutsu, revsets, change IDs, bookmarks, or oplog. Also trigger when the user wants to squash, split, or reorder commits in a stack, write a revset query, absorb fixup changes, undo or restore a previous operation, resolve conflicts after rebasing, recover from force-pushes, rewrite protected/immutable commits, view change evolution (evolog), or try parallel approaches. Trigger even if "jj" is not explicitly said — "changes" instead of "commits", "stack" instead of "branch", "absorb", "squash into the right commit", "undo my last operation", "conflict after rebase", or "compare approaches in parallel" are strong jj signals. This skill contains critical non-obvious rules (like always using -m flags) that prevent broken workflows.
trevors/dot-claude/using-jj.descriptionEn: Use this skill for ANY task involving jj or jujutsu version control. ALWAYS trigger when the user mentions jj, jujutsu, revsets, change IDs, bookmarks, or oplog. Also trigger when the user wants to squash, split, or reorder commits in a stack, write a revset query, absorb fixup changes, undo or restore a previous operation, resolve conflicts after rebasing, recover from force-pushes, rewrite protected/immutable commits, view change evolution (evolog), or try parallel approaches. Trigger even if "jj" is not explicitly said — "changes" instead of "commits", "stack" instead of "branch", "absorb", "squash into the right commit", "undo my last operation", "conflict after rebase", or "compare approaches in parallel" are strong jj signals. This skill contains critical non-obvious rules (like always using -m flags) that prevent broken workflows.
trevors/dot-claude/using-jj.descriptionCn: 将此技能用于任何涉及 jj 或 jujutsu 版本控制的任务。当用户提及 jj、jujutsu、revsets、更改 ID、书签或 oplog 时始终触发。当用户想要压缩、分割或重新排序堆栈中的提交、编写修订集查询、吸收修复更改、撤消或恢复先前的操作、解决变基后的冲突、从强制推送中恢复、重写受保护/不可变的提交、查看更改演变 (evolog) 或尝试并行方法时，也会触发。即使没有明确说出“jj”，也会触发 - “更改”而不是“提交”、“堆栈”而不是“分支”、“吸收”、“压缩到正确的提交”、“撤消我的上一个操作”、“变基后冲突”或“并行比较方法”都是强 jj 信号。该技能包含关键的非显而易见的规则（例如始终使用 -m 标志），可以防止工作流程中断。

tukaelu/agent-skills/proofreader.title: proofreader
tukaelu/agent-skills/proofreader.description:
文章の校正・推敲を行うスキル。誤字脱字・文法ミス・表現の改善点を指摘し、修正案を提示する。

スラッシュコマンドで呼び出されたとき（例: `/proofreader report.md` や `/proofreader ./docs/readme.txt`）は、引数に渡されたファイルを読み込んで校正を行う。

「校正して」「推敲して」「文章を見直して」「誤字脱字チェックして」「ちゃんと校正してよ」など、文章の品質確認や修正を求められたときは、直前にセッション内で生成・提示した文面を校正する。対象が複数ある場合や不明な場合は確認する。

日本語・英語どちらの文章にも対応する。メールの草稿・ドキュメント・ブログ記事・コードのコメントなど、文章であれば種類を問わず校正できる。

校正・推敲・誤字チェックの依頼があったときは必ずこのスキルを参照すること。
tukaelu/agent-skills/proofreader.descriptionEn:

tukaelu/agent-skills/proofreader.descriptionCn:
校对和修改文本的技能。它会发现拼写错误、语法错误以及需要更好措辞的地方，然后提供更正。

当通过斜杠命令（例如“/proofreader report.md”或“/proofreader ./docs/readme.txt”）调用时，它会读取指定的文件并对其进行校对。

当被要求“校对”、“修改”、“检查拼写错误”、“正确校对”等时，它会更正会话中最近生成或显示的文本。如果存在多个或不明确的目标，则要求确认。

可以处理日语和英语。可以校对任何书面内容：电子邮件草稿、文档、博客文章、代码注释——无限制。

每当需要校对、修改或打字检查时，请务必查阅此技能。

tukaelu/agent-skills/researcher.description:
あるテーマや課題について、定量・定性の調査を通じて事実や意見を収集・分析し、意思決定に役立つ知見を提供するリサーチスキル。ユーザーとの壁打ちを通じてテーマを深掘りしながら調査を進め、構造化されたレポートや示唆として提供する。

以下の場面では必ず起動する：
- 「調べて」「リサーチして」「調査して」「〇〇について知りたい」と言われたとき
- 市場動向・技術トレンド・競合分析・業界動向・社会課題などの調査が必要なとき
- 「壁打ちしたい」「一緒に考えたい」「課題を整理したい」「情報を整理してほしい」という場合
- 意思決定のために複数の視点や選択肢を比較・整理したいとき
- 特定のテーマについて現状・課題・展望を把握したいとき

一种研究技能，通过对给定主题或问题进行定量和定性调查来收集和分析事实和观点，为决策提供见解。它通过与用户集思广益深化主题来推进调查，并将调查结果作为结构化报告或建议提供。

请务必在以下情况下激活：
- 当被要求“调查”、“研究”、“调查”或“告诉我〇〇”时

- 当有人说“我想集思广益”、“让我们一起思考”、“我需要解决问题”或“请整理信息”时
- 比较和组织多个观点或选项进行决策时
- 想要掌握特定主题的现状、挑战和前景时

Technical founder review of a plan before execution. Reads a plan from plans/<name>.md,
verifies file paths exist, challenges scope and architecture decisions, audits risk coverage
and test gaps, scores sections, and delivers a verdict (APPROVE/REVISE/REJECT).
Invoke via /plan-founder-review or when user says "review my plan", "check the plan".
ulpi-io/skills/plan-founder-review.descriptionEn:
Technical founder review of a plan before execution. Reads a plan from plans/<name>.md,
verifies file paths exist, challenges scope and architecture decisions, audits risk coverage
and test gaps, scores sections, and delivers a verdict (APPROVE/REVISE/REJECT).
Invoke via /plan-founder-review or when user says "review my plan", "check the plan".
ulpi-io/skills/plan-founder-review.descriptionCn:
技术创始人在执行前对计划进行审查。从plans/<name>.md 读取计划，
验证文件路径是否存在，挑战范围和架构决策，审核风险覆盖范围
并测试差距，对部分进行评分，并做出裁决（批准/修改/拒绝）。
通过 /plan-Founder-review 调用或当用户说“查看我的计划”、“检查计划”时调用。

ulpi-io/skills/plan-to-task-list-with-da.title: plan-to-task-list-with-dag
ulpi-io/skills/plan-to-task-list-with-da.description: Interactive build planner — explores codebase via CodeMap, challenges scope with user, decomposes features into atomic TASK-NNN entries with dependency mapping and priority assignment, produces machine-parseable task plans for parallel agent execution. Use when you need to break a feature, bug fix, or project into a structured DAG of tasks for parallel agent execution.
ulpi-io/skills/plan-to-task-list-with-da.descriptionEn: Interactive build planner — explores codebase via CodeMap, challenges scope with user, decomposes features into atomic TASK-NNN entries with dependency mapping and priority assignment, produces machine-parseable task plans for parallel agent execution. Use when you need to break a feature, bug fix, or project into a structured DAG of tasks for parallel agent execution.
ulpi-io/skills/plan-to-task-list-with-da.descriptionCn: 交互式构建规划器 - 通过 CodeMap 探索代码库，与用户挑战范围，将功能分解为具有依赖关系映射和优先级分配的原子 TASK-NNN 条目，为并行代理执行生成机器可解析的任务计划。当您需要将功能、错误修复或项目分解为任务的结构化 DAG 以便并行代理执行时使用。

ulpi-io/skills/pr-retro.title: pr-retro
ulpi-io/skills/pr-retro.description: Use when the user asks for a branch retrospective, pre-PR analysis, branch health check, or says "/pr-retro". Analyzes all commits on the current branch vs base (main..HEAD), computes size metrics, test LOC ratio, focus score, session analysis, commit hygiene, contributor breakdown, self-review scan (TODOs, debug artifacts, .only, secrets), and delivers a merge readiness verdict (GREEN/YELLOW/RED). Supports --quick (dashboard only) and --base <branch> (custom base). Saves JSON snapshot to .history/pr-retros/.
ulpi-io/skills/pr-retro.descriptionEn: Use when the user asks for a branch retrospective, pre-PR analysis, branch health check, or says "/pr-retro". Analyzes all commits on the current branch vs base (main..HEAD), computes size metrics, test LOC ratio, focus score, session analysis, commit hygiene, contributor breakdown, self-review scan (TODOs, debug artifacts, .only, secrets), and delivers a merge readiness verdict (GREEN/YELLOW/RED). Supports --quick (dashboard only) and --base <branch> (custom base). Saves JSON snapshot to .history/pr-retros/.
ulpi-io/skills/pr-retro.descriptionCn: 当用户请求分支回顾、PR 前分析、分支运行状况检查或说“/pr-retro”时使用。分析当前分支与基础（main..HEAD）上的所有提交，计算大小指标、测试 LOC 比率、焦点分数、会话分析、提交卫生、贡献者细分、自我审查扫描（TODO、调试工件、.only、秘密），并提供合并就绪判定（绿色/黄色/红色）。支持 --quick （仅限仪表板）和 --base <branch> （自定义基础）。将 JSON 快照保存到 .history/pr-retros/。

unix2dos/skills/code-simplifier.title: code-simplifier
unix2dos/skills/code-simplifier.description: 代码简化与优化专家/代码简化。Use this agent when you need to simplify, optimize, refactor, or clean up code. This agent helps reduce complexity, improve readability, and ensure code follows best practices like YAGNI, KISS, and DRY principles. Supports two modes: analysis mode (provides simplification suggestions) and execution mode (directly modifies code). Works with any programming language. Examples: <example>Context: User wants to simplify complex code. user: "这段代码太复杂了，帮我简化一下" assistant: "Let me analyze and simplify this code using the code-simplifier agent" <commentary>Use code-simplifier to reduce complexity and improve readability.</commentary></example> <example>Context: User wants a code review for optimization opportunities. user: "Review this function for optimization" assistant: "I'll use code-simplifier to identify optimization opportunities and suggest improvements" <commentary>Code-simplifier can analyze and provide optimization recommendations.</commentary></example>

This agent helps reduce complexity, improve readability, and ensure code follows best practices like YAGNI, KISS, and DRY principles. unix2dos/skills/code-simplifier.descriptionCn: 代码简化与优化专家/代码简化。当您需要简化、优化、重构或清理代码时，请使用此代理。该代理有助于降低复杂性、提高可读性，并确保代码遵循 YAGNI、KISS 和 DRY 原则等最佳实践。支持两种模式：分析模式（提供简化建议）和执行模式（直接修改代码）。适用于任何编程语言。示例： <example>上下文：用户想要简化复杂的代码。用户：“be代码太复杂了，帮我简化一下” 助理：“让我使用代码简化器代理来分析和简化此代码” <commentary>使用代码简化器来降低复杂性并提高可读性。</commentary></example> <example>上下文：用户希望进行代码审查以获得优化机会。用户：“查看此功能以进行优化” 助手：“我将使用 code-simplifier 来识别优化机会并提出改进建议” <commentary>Code-simplifier 可以分析并提供优化建议。</commentary></example>

valentinkolb/sync/sync-ephemeral.title: sync-ephemeral
valentinkolb/sync/sync-ephemeral.description: Use this skill when implementing short-lived typed state with @valentinkolb/sync ephemeral: TTL-based key/value with upsert/touch/remove, snapshot-plus-cursor reconciliation for cache hydration, streaming upsert/touch/delete/expire events, capacity/payload limits, and presence-style use cases where entries should naturally expire.
valentinkolb/sync/sync-ephemeral.descriptionEn: Use this skill when implementing short-lived typed state with @valentinkolb/sync ephemeral: TTL-based key/value with upsert/touch/remove, snapshot-plus-cursor reconciliation for cache hydration, streaming upsert/touch/delete/expire events, capacity/payload limits, and presence-style use cases where entries should naturally expire.

valentinkolb/sync/sync-job.title: sync-job
valentinkolb/sync/sync-job.description: Use this skill when implementing durable background jobs with @valentinkolb/sync job: defining typed process handlers with ctx.step/ctx.heartbeat/ctx.signal, submit/join/cancel flows, idempotent submission via key, retries with exponential backoff, lease timeouts, and per-job event streams for audit. Also use when choosing between job (durable execution with state) vs queue (simple work distribution).
valentinkolb/sync/sync-job.descriptionEn: Use this skill when implementing durable background jobs with @valentinkolb/sync job: defining typed process handlers with ctx.step/ctx.heartbeat/ctx.signal, submit/join/cancel flows, idempotent submission via key, retries with exponential backoff, lease timeouts, and per-job event streams for audit. valentinkolb/sync/sync-mutex.title: sync-mutex
valentinkolb/sync/sync-mutex.description: Use this skill when working with @valentinkolb/sync distributed locks: exclusive critical sections across pods with withLock/withLockOrThrow, manual acquire/release, lease extension for long work, retry tuning, owner-safe release via Lua, and LockError handling.
valentinkolb/sync/sync-mutex.descriptionEn: Use this skill when working with @valentinkolb/sync distributed locks: exclusive critical sections across pods with withLock/withLockOrThrow, manual acquire/release, lease extension for long work, retry tuning, owner-safe release via Lua, and LockError handling.

valentinkolb/sync/sync-queue.title: sync-queue
valentinkolb/sync/sync-queue.description: Use this skill when implementing durable queue processing with @valentinkolb/sync queue: send/recv/stream consumer loops, at-least-once delivery with ack/nack/touch, lease-based visibility timeout, delayed messages, DLQ behavior, idempotent enqueueing, and multi-tenant keyspaces. Also use when choosing between queue (work distribution) vs topic (event fan-out) vs job (durable execution with state).
valentinkolb/sync/sync-queue.descriptionEn: Use this skill when implementing durable queue processing with @valentinkolb/sync queue: send/recv/stream consumer loops, at-least-once delivery with ack/nack/touch, lease-based visibility timeout, delayed messages, DLQ behavior, idempotent enqueueing, and multi-tenant keyspaces. valentinkolb/sync/sync-ratelimit.title: sync-ratelimit

valentinkolb/sync/sync-ratelimit.descriptionEn: Use this skill when working with @valentinkolb/sync rate limiting in Bun/TypeScript: creating per-identifier sliding-window limiters, choosing check() vs checkOrThrow(), handling RateLimitError with resetIn/Retry-After headers, tuning window size, and reasoning about Redis key layout.

valentinkolb/sync/sync-retry.title: sync-retry

Also use when writing stream reader loops that must survive brief outages.

vtexdocs/ai-skills/faststore-theming.title: faststore-theming

vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-bff-architec.title: headless-bff-architecture

vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-caching-stra.title: headless-caching-strategy

wdavidturner/product-skills/monetizing-i.descriptionCn: 当被问及“定价策略”、“支付意愿”、“价值指标”、“包装等级”、“好更好的最佳定价”、“订阅与使用定价”或“产品之前的价格”时使用。帮助设计客户愿意付费的产品并选择能够获取价值的定价模型。基于 Simon-Kucher Madhavan Ramanujam 的货币化创新框架。

wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.title: okrs
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.description: Use when asked to "set OKRs", "objectives and key results", "quarterly OKR planning", "align objectives", "measure OKR progress", or "focus priorities with OKRs". Helps teams focus on what matters most and create a cadence of progress. Christina Wodtke's Radical Focus approach emphasizes simplicity and avoiding common pitfalls.
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "set OKRs", "objectives and key results", "quarterly OKR planning", "align objectives", "measure OKR progress", or "focus priorities with OKRs". Helps teams focus on what matters most and create a cadence of progress. The OKR framework (originated by Andy Grove at Intel, popularized by John Doerr at Google) creates alignment, focus, and learning cycles. Christina Wodtke's Radical Focus approach emphasizes simplicity and avoiding common pitfalls.
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.descriptionCn: 当被要求“设定 OKR”、“目标和关键结果”、“季度 OKR 规划”、“调整目标”、“衡量 OKR 进度”或“通过 OKR 关注优先事项”时使用。帮助团队专注于最重要的事情并创造进步的节奏。 OKR 框架（由英特尔的安迪·格罗夫 (Andy Grove) 发起，由谷歌的约翰·杜尔 (John Doerr) 推广）创建了一致性、焦点和学习周期。 Christina Wodtke 的激进聚焦方法强调简单性并避免常见的陷阱。

wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.title: opportunity-solution-trees
wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.description: Use when asked to "opportunity solution tree", "OST", "Teresa Torres", "map customer opportunities to outcomes", "structure discovery around opportunities", or "compare solutions for a customer need". wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "opportunity solution tree", "OST", "Teresa Torres", "map customer opportunities to outcomes", "structure discovery around opportunities", or "compare solutions for a customer need". Helps product teams connect outcomes to customer opportunities and test solutions with Opportunity Solution Trees (created by Teresa Torres).
wdavidturner/product-skills/opportunity-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“机会解决方案树”、“OST”、“Teresa Torres”、“将客户机会映射到结果”、“围绕机会构建发现”或“比较客户需求的解决方案”时使用。帮助产品团队将结果与客户机会联系起来，并使用机会解决方案树（由 Teresa Torres 创建）测试解决方案。

wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.title: pmf-survey
wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.description: Use when asked to "PMF survey", "measure product-market fit", "40% rule", "Sean Ellis test", "Rahul Vohra method", or "how disappointed would you be". Helps quantify product-market fit and systematically improve it. The PMF Survey framework (created by Sean Ellis, popularized by Rahul Vohra at Superhuman) measures how disappointed users would be without your product and turns that data into a roadmap.
wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "PMF survey", "measure product-market fit", "40% rule", "Sean Ellis test", "Rahul Vohra method", or "how disappointed would you be". Helps quantify product-market fit and systematically improve it. The PMF Survey framework (created by Sean Ellis, popularized by Rahul Vohra at Superhuman) measures how disappointed users would be without your product and turns that data into a roadmap.
wdavidturner/product-skills/pmf-survey.descriptionCn: 当被要求“PMF 调查”、“衡量产品市场契合度”、“40% 规则”、“Sean Ellis 测试”、“Rahul Vohra 方法”或“您会感到多么失望”时使用。帮助量化产品与市场的契合度并系统地改进它。 PMF 调查框架（由 Sean Ellis 创建，由 Super human 的 Rahul Vohra 推广）衡量如果没有您的产品，用户会有多失望，并将这些数据转化为路线图。

wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.title: positioning-canvas
wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.description: Use when asked to "position my product", "positioning canvas", "differentiate from competitors", "figure out our category", "repositioning", or "why customers should pick us". Helps define competitive alternatives, differentiated value, target customers, and market category. April Dunford's positioning framework from "Obviously Awesome" makes your product's value obvious to the right customers.
wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "position my product", "positioning canvas", "differentiate from competitors", "figure out our category", "repositioning", or "why customers should pick us". Helps define competitive alternatives, differentiated value, target customers, and market category. April Dunford's positioning framework from "Obviously Awesome" makes your product's value obvious to the right customers.
wdavidturner/product-skills/positioning-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“定位我的产品”、“定位画布”、“与竞争对手区分开来”、“弄清楚我们的类别”、“重新定位”或“为什么客户应该选择我们”时使用。帮助定义有竞争力的替代方案、差异化价值、目标客户和市场类别。 April Dunford 的“Obviously Awesome”定位框架使您的产品价值对合适的客户来说是显而易见的。

wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.title: product-led-growth
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.description: Use when asked about "product-led growth", "PLG strategy", "self-serve growth", "freemium model", "free trial design", "product-led sales", "PQL", or "bottoms-up growth". Helps design and optimize product-led growth motions where the product drives acquisition, activation, and monetization. Based on frameworks from Elena Verna and Hila Qu.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionEn: Use when asked about "product-led growth", "PLG strategy", "self-serve growth", "freemium model", "free trial design", "product-led sales", "PQL", or "bottoms-up growth". Helps design and optimize product-led growth motions where the product drives acquisition, activation, and monetization. Based on frameworks from Elena Verna and Hila Qu.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionCn: 当被问及“产品主导的增长”、“PLG 策略”、“自助增长”、“免费增值模式”、“免费试用设计”、“产品主导的销售”、“PQL”或“自下而上的增长”时使用。帮助设计和优化以产品为主导的增长动作，其中产品推动获取、激活和货币化。基于 Elena Verna 和 Hila Qu 的框架。

wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.title: product-led-seo
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.description: Use when asked to "product-led SEO", "programmatic SEO", "build programmatic pages", "organic acquisition for product", "decide if SEO is worth it", or "optimize for AI search". Helps evaluate whether SEO fits your business model and how to approach it as a product, not just marketing. The Product-Led SEO framework (created by Eli Schwartz) treats SEO as building products for search users.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "product-led SEO", "programmatic SEO", "build programmatic pages", "organic acquisition for product", "decide if SEO is worth it", or "optimize for AI search". Helps evaluate whether SEO fits your business model and how to approach it as a product, not just marketing. The Product-Led SEO framework (created by Eli Schwartz) treats SEO as building products for search users.
wdavidturner/product-skills/product-led-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“以产品为主导的 SEO”、“程序化 SEO”、“构建程序化页面”、“产品的有机获取”、“决定 SEO 是否值得”或“优化 AI 搜索”时使用。帮助评估 SEO 是否适合您的商业模式以及如何将其作为产品而不仅仅是营销。以产品为主导的 SEO 框架（由 Eli Schwartz 创建）将 SEO 视为为搜索用户构建产品。

wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.title: radical-candor
wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.description: Use when asked to "radical candor", "give feedback that cares", "have a difficult conversation", "challenge directly", "manage performance issues", or "give praise that lands". Helps deliver direct feedback while showing you care. The Radical Candor framework (created by Kim Scott) teaches how to challenge directly while caring personally.
wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "radical candor", "give feedback that cares", "have a difficult conversation", "challenge directly", "manage performance issues", or "give praise that lands". Helps deliver direct feedback while showing you care. The Radical Candor framework (created by Kim Scott) teaches how to challenge directly while caring personally.
wdavidturner/product-skills/radical-cand.descriptionCn: 当被要求“彻底坦率”、“提供关心的反馈”、“进行一次艰难的对话”、“直接挑战”、“管理绩效问题”或“给予有效的赞扬”时使用。帮助提供直接反馈，同时向您表示关心。 Radical Candor 框架（由 Kim Scott 创建）教导如何在关心个人的同时直接挑战。

wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.title: seven-powers
wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.description: Use when asked to "7 Powers", "build a competitive moat", "analyze defensibility", "find sustainable advantage", "economic moats", or "Hamilton Helmer framework". Helps identify durable competitive advantages. The 7 Powers framework (created by Hamilton Helmer) reveals the economic structures that protect business value from competition.
wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "7 Powers", "build a competitive moat", "analyze defensibility", "find sustainable advantage", "economic moats", or "Hamilton Helmer framework". Helps identify durable competitive advantages. The 7 Powers framework (created by Hamilton Helmer) reveals the economic structures that protect business value from competition.
wdavidturner/product-skills/seven-powers.descriptionCn: 当被要求“七大力量”、“建立竞争护城河”、“分析防御性”、“寻找可持续优势”、“经济护城河”或“汉密尔顿·赫尔默框架”时使用。帮助确定持久的竞争优势。七权框架（由 Hamilton Helmer 创建）揭示了保护商业价值免受竞争的经济结构。

wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.title: shape-up
wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.description: Use when asked to "shape up", "run a shaping session", "set an appetite", "scope a project without estimates", "betting table", or "ship in fixed cycles". Helps teams escape estimate-driven development and Scrum fatigue. The Shape Up method (created by Ryan Singer at Basecamp/37signals) uses fixed time boxes, variable scope, and collaborative shaping to ship meaningful work predictably.
wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "shape up", "run a shaping session", "set an appetite", "scope a project without estimates", "betting table", or "ship in fixed cycles". Helps teams escape estimate-driven development and Scrum fatigue. The Shape Up method (created by Ryan Singer at Basecamp/37signals) uses fixed time boxes, variable scope, and collaborative shaping to ship meaningful work predictably.
wdavidturner/product-skills/shape-up.descriptionCn: 当被要求“塑造”、“进行塑造会议”、“设定胃口”、“在没有估计的情况下确定项目范围”、“投注表”或“按固定周期发货”时使用。帮助团队摆脱估计驱动的开发和 Scrum 疲劳。 Shape Up 方法（由 Basecamp/37signals 的 Ryan Singer 创建）使用固定时间框、可变范围和协作塑造来可预测地交付有意义的工作。

wdavidturner/product-skills/strategic-na.title: strategic-narrative
wdavidturner/product-skills/strategic-na.description: Use when asked to "strategic narrative", "Andy Raskin", "tell our company story", "write a pitch deck", "explain why customers should care", or "movement narrative". Helps craft compelling narratives that define movements rather than just selling products. The Strategic Narrative framework (created by Andy Raskin) transforms pitches from feature lists into stories about change.
wdavidturner/product-skills/strategic-na.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "strategic narrative", "Andy Raskin", "tell our company story", "write a pitch deck", "explain why customers should care", or "movement narrative". Helps craft compelling narratives that define movements rather than just selling products. The Strategic Narrative framework (created by Andy Raskin) transforms pitches from feature lists into stories about change.

wdavidturner/product-skills/thinking-in-.title: thinking-in-bets
wdavidturner/product-skills/thinking-in-.description: Use when asked to "thinking in bets", "make decisions under uncertainty", "think probabilistically", "avoid resulting", "separate decision quality from outcomes", or "reduce bias in decisions". Helps make explicit bets and evaluate decisions on process, not results. The Thinking in Bets framework (from Annie Duke) applies poker strategy to business and life decisions.
wdavidturner/product-skills/thinking-in-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "thinking in bets", "make decisions under uncertainty", "think probabilistically", "avoid resulting", "separate decision quality from outcomes", or "reduce bias in decisions". Helps make explicit bets and evaluate decisions on process, not results. The Thinking in Bets framework (from Annie Duke) applies poker strategy to business and life decisions.
wdavidturner/product-skills/thinking-in-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“在赌注中思考”、“在不确定性下做出决定”、“概率性思考”、“避免结果”、“将决策质量与结果分开”或“减少决策中的偏差”时使用。帮助做出明确的赌注并根据过程而不是结果评估决策。投注思维框架（来自 Annie Duke）将扑克策略应用于商业和生活决策。

wdavidturner/product-skills/trustworthy-.title: trustworthy-experiments
wdavidturner/product-skills/trustworthy-.description: Use when asked to "run an A/B test", "design an experiment", "check statistical significance", "trust our results", "avoid false positives", or "experiment guardrails". Helps design, run, and interpret controlled experiments correctly. Based on Ronny Kohavi's framework from "Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments".
wdavidturner/product-skills/trustworthy-.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "run an A/B test", "design an experiment", "check statistical significance", "trust our results", "avoid false positives", or "experiment guardrails". Helps design, run, and interpret controlled experiments correctly. Based on Ronny Kohavi's framework from "Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments".
wdavidturner/product-skills/trustworthy-.descriptionCn: 当被要求“运行 A/B 测试”、“设计实验”、“检查统计显着性”、“相信我们的结果”、“避免误报”或“实验护栏”时使用。帮助正确设计、运行和解释受控实验。基于 Ronny Kohavi 的“值得信赖的在线控制实验”框架。

wdavidturner/product-skills/working-back.title: working-backwards

Helps define products by starting with the customer problem and desired outcome before building. wdavidturner/product-skills/working-back.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "working backwards", "PR/FAQ", "Amazon PR/FAQ", "write a press release", "define a new product", or "write a customer-focused PRD". Helps define products by starting with the customer problem and desired outcome before building. The Working Backwards process (developed at Amazon) forces clarity on customer value before committing engineering resources.
wdavidturner/product-skills/working-back.descriptionCn: 当被要求“逆向工作”、“公关/常见问题解答”、“亚马逊公关/常见问题解答”、“撰写新闻稿”、“定义新产品”或“撰写以客户为中心的 PRD”时使用。在构建之前从客户问题和期望结果开始帮助定义产品。逆向工作流程（由亚马逊开发）强制在投入工程资源之前明确客户价值。

wdkns/wdkns-skills/youtube-render-pdf.title: youtube-render-pdf
wdkns/wdkns-skills/youtube-render-pdf.description: Generate a professional, detailed, figure-rich LaTeX course note and final PDF from a YouTube lecture, tutorial, or technical talk. wdkns/wdkns-skills/youtube-render-pdf.descriptionEn: Generate a professional, detailed, figure-rich LaTeX course note and final PDF from a YouTube lecture, tutorial, or technical talk. Use when the user provides a YouTube URL and wants structured Chinese teaching notes that combine the video's title, chapters, diagrams, formulas, code, subtitle explanations, the original video cover on the front page, and a final synthesis chapter, with key frames extracted from the highest usable video resolution and inserted as figures, and where the final deliverable must include a rendered PDF.
wdkns/wdkns-skills/youtube-render-pdf.descriptionCn: 从 YouTube 讲座、教程或技术讲座中生成专业、详细、图形丰富的 LaTeX 课程笔记和最终 PDF。当用户提供 YouTube URL 并想要结构化中文教学笔记时使用，其中结合了视频的标题、章节、图表、公式、代码、字幕解释、首页上的原始视频封面和最终综合章节，以及从最高可用视频分辨率中提取的关键帧并以图形形式插入，并且最终交付成果必须包括渲染的 PDF。

wdm0006/python-skills/improving-python-c.title: improving-python-code-quality

weapp-vite/weapp-vite/native-to-weapp-vi.title: native-to-weapp-vite-wevu-migration
weapp-vite/weapp-vite/native-to-weapp-vi.description: Apply a structured migration workflow from native mini-program projects to weapp-vite and wevu. weapp-vite/weapp-vite/native-to-weapp-vi.descriptionEn: Apply a structured migration workflow from native mini-program projects to weapp-vite and wevu. weapp-vite/weapp-vite/playwright-cli.title: playwright-cli

weapp-vite/weapp-vite/playwright-cli.descriptionCn: 自动执行浏览器交互以进行 Web 测试、表单填写、屏幕截图和数据提取。当用户需要导航网站、与网页交互、填写表单、截取屏幕截图、测试 Web 应用程序或从网页中提取信息时使用。

weapp-vite/weapp-vite/weapp-vite-best-pr.title: weapp-vite-best-practices

weapp-vite/weapp-vite/weapp-vite-best-pr.descriptionEn: Apply production-ready best practices for weapp-vite projects. Use when creating or refactoring mini-program projects with weapp-vite, designing directory/config conventions, choosing subpackage and chunk strategy, enabling auto routes/components, setting CI/devtool workflows, or debugging build/output issues in `vite.config.ts` and `app.json`.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evaluation-anchor-checker
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Audit and rewrite evaluation/numeric claims to ensure they carry minimal protocol context (task + metric + constraint) and avoid underspecified model naming.
**Trigger**: evaluation anchor checker, numeric claim hygiene, underspecified numbers, protocol context, 评测锚点检查, 数字断言, 指标上下文.
**Use when**: before final merge/polish, or when reviewers would likely flag claims as underspecified (numbers without task/metric/budget), or `pipeline-auditor` warns about suspicious model naming.
**Skip if**: evidence is too thin to justify numeric claims (route upstream to C3/C4), or you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent numbers; do not add/remove/move citation keys; if protocol context is missing, weaken/remove the numeric claim rather than guessing.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.descriptionCn:
审核和重写评估/数字声明，以确保它们携带最少的协议上下文（任务+度量+约束）并避免未指定的模型命名。
**触发器**：评估锚点检查器、数字声明卫生、未指定的数字、协议上下文、足球变量点检查、数字断言、指标上下文。
**使用时间**：在最终合并/完善之前，或者当审阅者可能将声明标记为未指定（没有任务/指标/预算的数字）时，或者“管道审核器”警告可疑模型命名时。
**如果**则跳过：证据太薄弱，无法证明数字主张的合理性（上游路线至 C3/C4），或者您处于 C2 之前（无散文）。
**网络**：无。
**护栏**：不要发明数字；不要添加/删除/移动引文键；如果协议上下文缺失，则削弱/删除数字声明而不是猜测。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evidence-auditor
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Audit the evidence supporting each claim and write gaps/concerns into `output/MISSING_EVIDENCE.md`.
**Trigger**: evidence audit, missing evidence, unsupported claims, 审稿证据审计, 证据缺口.
**Use when**: peer review 流程中，需要逐条检查 claim 的证据链、缺 baseline、评测薄弱点。
**Skip if**: 缺少 claims 输入（例如还没有 `output/CLAIMS.md`）。
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: 只写“缺口/风险/下一步验证”，不要替作者补写论述或引入新主张。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evidence-binder
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Bind addressable evidence IDs from `papers/evidence_bank.jsonl` to each subsection (H3), producing `outline/evidence_bindings.jsonl`.
**Trigger**: evidence binder, evidence plan, section->evidence mapping, 证据绑定, evidence_id.
**Use when**: `papers/evidence_bank.jsonl` exists and you want writer/auditor to use section-scoped evidence items (WebWeaver-style memory bank).
**Skip if**: you are not doing evidence-first section-by-section writing.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: NO PROSE; do not invent evidence; only select from the existing evidence bank.

**触发器**：证据活页夹、证据计划、部分->证据映射、证据绑定、evidence_id。
**当**使用：存在 `papers/evidence_bank.jsonl` 并且您希望作者/审核员使用部分范围的证据项（WebWeaver 样式的内存库）。

**护栏**：没有散文；不要发明证据；仅从现有证据库中选择。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evidence-draft
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Create per-subsection evidence packs (NO PROSE): claim candidates, concrete comparisons, evaluation protocol, limitations, plus citation-backed evidence snippets with provenance.
**Trigger**: evidence draft, evidence pack, claim candidates, concrete comparisons, evidence snippets, provenance, 证据草稿, 证据包, 可引用事实.
**Use when**: `outline/subsection_briefs.jsonl` exists and you want evidence-first section drafting where every paragraph can be backed by traceable citations/snippets.
**Skip if**: `outline/evidence_drafts.jsonl` already exists and is refined (no placeholders; >=8 comparisons per subsection; `blocking_missing` empty).
**Network**: none (richer evidence improves with abstracts/fulltext).
**Guardrail**: NO PROSE; do not invent facts; only use citation keys that exist in `citations/ref.bib`.

**触发器**：证据草稿、证据包、候选主张、具体比较、证据片段、出处、证据草稿、证据包、可引用事实。
**当**存在`outline/subsection_briefs.jsonl`并且您想要证据第一的部分起草时使用，其中每个段落都可以由可追踪的引用/片段支持。
**如果**跳过： `outline/evidence_drafts.jsonl` 已经存在并且已完善（无占位符；每小节 >=8 次比较； `blocking_missing` 为空）。
**网络**：无（通过摘要/全文可以得到更丰富的证据）。
**护栏**：没有散文；不要捏造事实；仅使用存在于 `itations/ref.bib` 中的引文键。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evidence-selfloop
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Evidence self-loop for surveys: read evidence bindings + evidence packs, then write an actionable upstream TODO plan (which stage/skill to fix) before writing more prose.
Writes `output/EVIDENCE_SELFLOOP_TODO.md`.
**Trigger**: evidence self-loop, evidence loop, evidence gaps, binding gaps, blocking_missing, 证据自循环, 证据缺口回路.
**Use when**: C4 outputs exist (`outline/evidence_bindings.jsonl`, `outline/evidence_drafts.jsonl`) but writing looks hollow or C5 is BLOCKED due to thin evidence.
**Skip if**: you are still pre-C3 (no notes/evidence bank yet), or you want to draft anyway and accept a lower evidence bar.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: analysis-only; do not edit evidence/writing artifacts; do not invent facts/citations; only write the TODO report.

写入“output/EVIDENCE_SELFLOOP_TODO.md”。
**触发器**：证据自循环、证据循环、证据间隙、绑定间隙、blocking_missing、证据自循环、证据缺口回路。
**在以下情况下使用**：C4 输出存在（`outline/evidence_bindings.jsonl`、`outline/evidence_drafts.jsonl`），但书写看起来很空洞，或者 C5 由于证据不足而被阻止。

**网络**：无。
**护栏**：仅分析；不要编辑证据/书写工件；不要发明事实/引文；只写TODO报告。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: exercise-builder
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Add exercises to each tutorial module (inputs, expected outputs, verification steps) and update `outline/module_plan.yml`.
**Trigger**: exercises, practice, verification checklist, 教程练习, 可验证作业.
**Use when**: 已有模块计划（`outline/module_plan.yml`），需要为每个模块补齐至少 1 个可验证练习以形成 teaching loop。
**Skip if**: 还没有 module plan（先跑 `module-planner`）。
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: 每个练习必须包含 expected output + verification steps；避免只给“思考题”无验收。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: extraction-form
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Extract study data into a structured table (`papers/extraction_table.csv`) using the protocol’s extraction schema.
**Trigger**: extraction form, extraction table, data extraction, 信息提取, 提取表.
**Use when**: systematic review 在 screening 后进入 extraction（C3），需要把纳入论文按字段落到 CSV 以支持后续 synthesis。
**Skip if**: 还没有 `papers/screening_log.csv` 或 protocol 未锁定。
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: 严格按 schema 填字段；不要在此阶段写 narrative synthesis（那是 `synthesis-writer`）。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: front-matter-writer
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Write the survey\x27s front matter files (Abstract, Introduction, Related Work, Discussion, Conclusion) in paper voice, with high citation density and a single evidence-policy paragraph.
**Trigger**: front matter writer, introduction writer, related work writer, abstract writer, discussion writer, conclusion writer, 引言, 相关工作, 摘要, 讨论, 结论.
**Use when**: you are in C5 (prose allowed) and need the paper-like \"shell\" to stop the draft reading like stitched subsections.
**Skip if**: `Approve C2` is missing in `DECISIONS.md`, or `citations/ref.bib` is missing (generate citations first).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: no pipeline jargon in final prose; no repeated evidence disclaimers; do not invent facts/citations; only use keys present in `citations/ref.bib`.

**触发**：前文作者、引言作者、相关作品作者、摘要作者、讨论作者、结论作者、引言、相关工作、摘要、讨论、结论。
**使用时**：你处于C5（允许散文）并且需要像纸一样的“外壳”来阻止草稿像缝合的小节一样阅读。
**如果**跳过：“DECISIONS.md”中缺少“Approve C2”，或者缺少“itations/ref.bib”（首先生成引文）。
**网络**：无。
**护栏**：最终散文中没有管道术语；无重复证据免责声明；不要发明事实/引文；仅使用“引用/ref.bib”中存在的键。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: global-reviewer
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Global consistency review for survey drafts: terminology, cross-section coherence, and scope/citation hygiene.
Writes `output/GLOBAL_REVIEW.md` and (optionally) applies safe edits to `output/DRAFT.md`.
**Trigger**: global review, consistency check, coherence audit, 术语一致性, 全局回看, 章节呼应, 拷打 writer.
**Use when**: Draft exists and you want a final evidence-first coherence pass before LaTeX/PDF.
**Skip if**: You are still changing the outline/mapping/notes (do those first), or prose writing is not approved.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: Do not invent facts or citations; do not add new citation keys; treat missing evidence as a failure signal.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: grad-paragraph

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: human-checkpoint
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:

**Guardrail**: do not invent papers/citations; do not start retrieval here; keep the brief structured (no long prose).

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: limitation-weaver
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Rewrite limitation passages so the paper keeps limitations without falling into count-based slot phrases (e.g., \"Two limitations…\") across many H3s.
**Trigger**: limitation weaver, rewrite limitations, remove two limitations, 去Two limitations, 局限改写, caveat rewrite.
**Use when**: `writer-selfloop` is PASS but flags repeated count-based limitation openers in `output/WRITER_SELFLOOP_TODO.md`, or multiple H3s share the same limitation cadence.
**Skip if**: the limitation is evidence-missing (route upstream), or you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; do not add/remove/move citation keys; do not delete subsection-specific limitations; keep claim→evidence anchoring intact.

**触发**：限制编织、重写限制、去掉两个限制、去两个限制、捂重写、警告重写。
**使用条件**：`writer-selfloop` 为 PASS，但在 `output/WRITER_SELFLOOP_TODO.md` 中标记重复的基于计数的限制开启器，或者多个 H3 共享相同的限制节奏。
**如果**则跳过：限制缺乏证据（上游路由），或者您是 C2 预选者（NO PROSE）。
**网络**：无。
**护栏**：不要编造事实；不要添加/删除/移动引文键；不要删除特定于小节的限制；保持主张→证据锚定完整。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: literature-engineer
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Multi-route literature expansion + metadata normalization for evidence-first surveys.
Produces a large candidate pool (`papers/papers_raw.jsonl`, target ≥1200) with stable IDs and provenance, ready for dedupe/rank + citation generation.
**Trigger**: evidence collector, literature engineer, 文献扩充, 多路召回, snowballing, cited by, references, 元信息增强, provenance.
**Use when**: 需要把候选文献扩充到 ≥1200 篇并补齐可追溯 meta（survey pipeline 的 Stage C1，写作前置 evidence）。
**Skip if**: 已经有高质量 `papers/papers_raw.jsonl`（≥1200 且每条都有稳定标识+来源记录）。
**Network**: 可离线（靠 imports）；雪崩/在线检索需要网络。
**Guardrail**: 不允许编造论文；每条记录必须带稳定标识（arXiv id / DOI / 可信 URL）和 provenance；不写 output/ prose。

多途径文献扩展+元数据标准化，用于证据优先调查。
生成一个具有稳定 ID 和出处的大型候选池（`papers/papers_raw.jsonl`，目标 ≥1200），为重复数据删除/排名 + 引文生成做好准备。
**触发器**：证据收集者、文献工程师、文献增强、多路认知、滚雪球、引用、参考文献、元信息增强、出处。
**使用时**：需要把候选文献补充到≥1200篇并补齐可补充元（调查管道的阶段C1，写作前置证据）。
**如果**则跳过：已经有高质量`papers/papers_raw.jsonl`（≥1200且每条都有稳定+标识来源记录）。
**网络**：可离线（靠进口）；雪崩/在线搜索需要网络。
**Guardrail**：不允许编造论文；每条记录必须带稳定标识（arXiv id / DOI / 可信 URL）和出处；不写输出/散文。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: manuscript-ingest
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Ingest a submitted manuscript into plain text (`output/PAPER.md`) so downstream review skills can extract claims with source pointers.
**Trigger**: ingest paper, manuscript text, provide paper, paper.md, 输入论文, 导入稿件, 审稿输入.
**Use when**: You are running the `peer-review` pipeline and need `output/PAPER.md` before `claims-extractor`.
**Skip if**: `output/PAPER.md` already exists and looks like the full manuscript text.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: Do not summarize or rewrite the paper; store the raw text (or a faithful extraction) so claims stay traceable.

**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not add/remove citation keys; do not introduce new claims; avoid moving citations across subsections.

**Guardrail**: do not add new factual claims or citations; transitions may only refer to titles/RQs/bridge terms already present in briefs.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: workspace-init

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: writer-context-pack
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Build per-H3 writer context packs (NO PROSE): merge briefs + evidence packs + anchor facts + allowed citations into a single deterministic JSONL, so drafting is less hollow and less brittle.
**Trigger**: writer context pack, context pack, drafting pack, paragraph plan pack, 写作上下文包.
**Use when**: `outline/subsection_briefs.jsonl` + `outline/evidence_drafts.jsonl` + `outline/anchor_sheet.jsonl` exist and you want to make C5 drafting easier/more consistent.
**Skip if**: upstream evidence is missing or scaffolded (fix `paper-notes` / `evidence-binder` / `evidence-draft` / `anchor-sheet` first).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: NO PROSE; do not invent facts/citations; only use citation keys present in `citations/ref.bib`.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.descriptionCn:

**触发器**：作家语境包、语境包、起草包、段落计划包、写作上下文包。
**当**使用： `outline/subsection_briefs.jsonl` + `outline/evidence_drafts.jsonl` + `outline/anchor_sheet.jsonl` 存在并且您希望使 C5 起草更容易/更一致。
**如果**则跳过：上游证据丢失或被搭建（首先修复 `paper-notes` / `evidence-binder` / `evidence-draft` / `anchor-sheet`）。
**网络**：无。
**护栏**：没有散文；不要发明事实/引文；仅使用“引用/ref.bib”中存在的引文键。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: writer-selfloop
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Writing self-loop for surveys: run the strict section-quality gate, then rewrite only the failing `sections/*.md` files until the report is PASS.
**Trigger**: writer self-loop, writing loop, quality gate loop, rewrite failing sections, 自循环, 反复改到 PASS.
**Use when**: per-section files exist but C5 is FAIL/BLOCKED (thin sections, missing leads/front matter, citation-scope violations, generator voice).
**Skip if**: you are still pre-C2 (NO PROSE), or evidence packs are incomplete (fix C3/C4 first).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; only use citation keys present in `citations/ref.bib`; keep citations in-scope per `outline/evidence_bindings.jsonl`; do not add/remove citation keys during rewrites.
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.descriptionEn:

**Trigger**: writer self-loop, writing loop, quality gate loop, rewrite failing sections, 自循环, 反复改到 PASS.
**Use when**: per-section files exist but C5 is FAIL/BLOCKED (thin sections, missing leads/front matter, citation-scope violations, generator voice).
**Skip if**: you are still pre-C2 (NO PROSE), or evidence packs are incomplete (fix C3/C4 first).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; only use citation keys present in `citations/ref.bib`; keep citations in-scope per `outline/evidence_bindings.jsonl`; do not add/remove citation keys during rewrites.
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.descriptionCn:
为调查编写自循环：运行严格的部分质量门，然后仅重写失败的“sections/*.md”文件，直到报告通过。
**触发器**：作者自循环、写作循环、质量门循环、重写失败部分、自循环、反复修改到通过。
**在以下情况下使用**：每个部分的文件存在，但 C5 失败/被阻止（薄部分、缺少线索/前言、引用范围违规、生成器语音）。
**如果**则跳过：您仍处于 C2 之前（没有 PROSE），或者证据包不完整（首先修复 C3/C4）。
**网络**：无。
**护栏**：不要编造事实；仅使用“引用/ref.bib”中存在的引文键；将引用保持在“outline/evidence_bindings.jsonl”范围内；重写期间不要添加/删除引用键。

wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.title: postgresql-best-practices
wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.description:
PostgreSQL 18+ comprehensive best practices for enterprise database development. Provides schema
architecture patterns, Table API design, PL/pgSQL coding standards, migrations, and data warehousing.

USE THIS SKILL WHEN THE USER:
- Creates PostgreSQL schemas, tables, functions, procedures, or triggers
- Asks about PostgreSQL data types (uuid, text, timestamptz, jsonb, numeric)
- Writes PL/pgSQL code and needs naming conventions (l_, in_, io_, co_ prefixes)
- Implements Table API pattern (SECURITY DEFINER functions, schema separation)
- Sets up database migrations or schema versioning
- Needs index optimization, constraint design, or query performance help
- Asks about PostgreSQL 18+ features (uuidv7, virtual columns, temporal constraints)
- Builds data warehouses with Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
- Needs data lineage tracking, ETL patterns, or audit logging
- Reviews database code for best practices or anti-patterns
- Migrates from Oracle PL/SQL to PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL
- Sets up CI/CD pipelines for database changes

CORE PATTERNS:
- Three-schema separation: data (tables) → private (internal) → api (external)
- Table API: All access through SECURITY DEFINER functions with SET search_path
- Native migration system: Pure PL/pgSQL alternative to Flyway/Liquibase
- Trivadis naming: l_ (local), in_ (input), io_ (inout), co_ (constant)

wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.descriptionCn:
PostgreSQL 18+ 企业数据库开发的全面最佳实践。提供架构
架构模式、表 API 设计、PL/pgSQL 编码标准、迁移和数据仓库。

当用户出现以下情况时使用此技能：
- 创建 PostgreSQL 模式、表、函数、过程或触发器
- 询问 PostgreSQL 数据类型（uuid、text、timestamptz、jsonb、numeric）
- 编写 PL/pgSQL 代码并需要命名约定（l_、in_、io_、co_ 前缀）
- 实现表 API 模式（SECURITY DEFINER 函数、模式分离）
- 设置数据库迁移或架构版本控制
- 需要索引优化、约束设计或查询性能帮助
- 询问 PostgreSQL 18+ 功能（uuidv7、虚拟列、时间约束）
- 使用 Medallion 架构构建数据仓库（铜牌/银牌/金牌）
- 需要数据沿袭跟踪、ETL 模式或审核日志记录
- 审查数据库代码的最佳实践或反模式
- 从 Oracle PL/SQL 迁移到 PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL
- 为数据库更改设置 CI/CD 管道

核心模式：
- 三模式分离：数据（表）→私有（内部）→api（外部）
- 表 API：通过带有 SET search_path 的 SECURITY DEFINER 函数进行所有访问
- 原生迁移系统：Flyway/Liquibase 的纯 PL/pgSQL 替代方案
- Trivadis 命名：l_（本地）、in_（输入）、io_（输入输出）、co_（常量）

Enforces a plan-build-verify-document lifecycle by routing all implementation work to sub-agent skills (ws-planner, ws-dev, ws-verifier, ws-codebase-documenter) via Task() delegation. Manages session state, survives context compaction, and prevents architectural drift. Use as the default operating mode for all development sessions.
wondersauce/claude-code-plugin/ws-orches.descriptionEn: Development orchestrator for Claude Code sessions. wondersauce/claude-code-plugin/ws-planne.title: ws-planner

Given a task description and project documentation, produces fully specified, structured development plans. Determines what to build, how to structure it per existing patterns, how to decompose into sub-tasks, and what constraints apply. Returns Task Definition arrays that ws-dev can execute without making architectural decisions.
wondersauce/claude-code-plugin/ws-planne.descriptionEn: Development planner for the ws-orchestrator lifecycle. wondersauce/claude-code-plugin/ws-verifi.title: ws-verifier

wyattowalsh/agents/data-wizard.description: Analyze data and guide ML: EDA, model selection, feature engineering, stats, visualization, MLOps. Use for data work. NOT for ETL, database design (database-architect), or frontend viz code.
wyattowalsh/agents/data-wizard.descriptionEn: Analyze data and guide ML: EDA, model selection, feature engineering, stats, visualization, MLOps. Use for data work. NOT for ETL, database design (database-architect), or frontend viz code.
wyattowalsh/agents/data-wizard.descriptionCn: 分析数据并指导 ML：EDA、模型选择、特征工程、统计、可视化、MLOps。用于数据工作。不适用于 ETL、数据库设计（数据库架构师）或前端可视化代码。

wyattowalsh/agents/database-architect.title: database-architect
wyattowalsh/agents/database-architect.description: Design schemas, plan migrations, and optimize queries. Six modes from modeling to evolution. Use for database architecture. NOT for DBA ops, backups, or deployment (devops-engineer).
wyattowalsh/agents/database-architect.descriptionEn: Design schemas, plan migrations, and optimize queries. Six modes from modeling to evolution. Use for database architecture. NOT for DBA ops, backups, or deployment (devops-engineer).
wyattowalsh/agents/database-architect.descriptionCn: 设计架构、规划迁移并优化查询。从建模到进化的六种模式。用于数据库架构。不适用于 DBA 操作、备份或部署（devops-engineer）。

wyattowalsh/agents/devops-engineer.title: devops-engineer
wyattowalsh/agents/devops-engineer.description: Design, optimize, and debug CI/CD pipelines. GitHub Actions and GitLab CI patterns. Use for pipeline work. NOT for infrastructure provisioning (infrastructure-coder) or app code.
wyattowalsh/agents/devops-engineer.descriptionEn: Design, optimize, and debug CI/CD pipelines. GitHub Actions and GitLab CI patterns. Use for pipeline work. NOT for infrastructure provisioning (infrastructure-coder) or app code.
wyattowalsh/agents/devops-engineer.descriptionCn: 设计、优化和调试 CI/CD 管道。 GitHub Actions 和 GitLab CI 模式。用于管道作业。不适用于基础设施配置（基础设施编码器）或应用程序代码。

wyattowalsh/agents/docs-steward.title: docs-steward
wyattowalsh/agents/docs-steward.description: Maintain and enhance the Astro+Starlight docs site. Syncs generated pages, scores content quality, performs health checks, and proposes site improvements. Use when skills, agents, or MCP servers change. NOT for writing skills, creating agents, or building MCP servers.
wyattowalsh/agents/docs-steward.descriptionEn: Maintain and enhance the Astro+Starlight docs site. Syncs generated pages, scores content quality, performs health checks, and proposes site improvements. Use when skills, agents, or MCP servers change. NOT for writing skills, creating agents, or building MCP servers.
wyattowalsh/agents/docs-steward.descriptionCn: 维护和增强 Astro+Starlight 文档站点。同步生成的页面、对内容质量进行评分、执行运行状况检查并提出站点改进建议。当技能、代理或 MCP 服务器发生变化时使用。不适用于写作技能、创建代理或构建 MCP 服务器。

wyattowalsh/agents/email-whiz.title: email-whiz
wyattowalsh/agents/email-whiz.description: Gmail inbox copilot via MCP. Triage, inbox zero with streak tracking, smart filters, auto-rules, analytics, newsletters, labels, search, senders, digest, cleanup, audit. Use when overwhelmed by email or building Gmail filters. NOT for: composing emails, calendar, Google Drive, non-Gmail.
wyattowalsh/agents/email-whiz.descriptionEn: Gmail inbox copilot via MCP. Triage, inbox zero with streak tracking, smart filters, auto-rules, analytics, newsletters, labels, search, senders, digest, cleanup, audit. Use when overwhelmed by email or building Gmail filters. NOT for: composing emails, calendar, Google Drive, non-Gmail.
wyattowalsh/agents/email-whiz.descriptionCn: 通过 MCP 的 Gmail 收件箱副驾驶。分类、收件箱清零，带连续跟踪、智能过滤器、自动规则、分析、时事通讯、标签、搜索、发件人、摘要、清理、审核。当您被电子邮件淹没或构建 Gmail 过滤器时使用。不适用于：撰写电子邮件、日历、Google Drive、非 Gmail。

wyattowalsh/agents/frontend-designer.title: frontend-designer
wyattowalsh/agents/frontend-designer.description: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with modern React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. Five modes: scaffold projects, create components, configure themes and design tokens, refactor styles, and audit codebases. Encodes best practices for React 19 Server Components (framework-dependent), TailwindCSS v4 CSS-first config, shadcn/ui with Radix primitives, modern CSS (container queries, :has(), view transitions, scroll-driven animations), Monaspace typography, and Vite 6. Supersedes the frontend-design skill. Use when building, styling, theming, or improving any frontend project. NOT for backend APIs, database design, DevOps, testing frameworks, state management libraries, routing, or full SSR framework setup.
wyattowalsh/agents/frontend-designer.descriptionEn: Build production-grade frontend interfaces with modern React, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. Five modes: scaffold projects, create components, configure themes and design tokens, refactor styles, and audit codebases. Encodes best practices for React 19 Server Components (framework-dependent), TailwindCSS v4 CSS-first config, shadcn/ui with Radix primitives, modern CSS (container queries, :has(), view transitions, scroll-driven animations), Monaspace typography, and Vite 6. Supersedes the frontend-design skill. Use when building, styling, theming, or improving any frontend project. NOT for backend APIs, database design, DevOps, testing frameworks, state management libraries, routing, or full SSR framework setup.
wyattowalsh/agents/frontend-designer.descriptionCn: 使用现代 React、Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 构建生产级前端界面。五种模式：脚手架项目、创建组件、配置主题和设计令牌、重构样式和审核代码库。编码 React 19 服务器组件（依赖于框架）、TailwindCSS v4 CSS-first 配置、带有 Radix 原语的 shadcn/ui、现代 CSS（容器查询、:has()、视图转换、滚动驱动动画）、Monaspace 排版和 Vite 6 的最佳实践。取代前端设计技能。在构建、样式化、主题化或改进任何前端项目时使用。不适用于后端 API、数据库设计、DevOps、测试框架、状态管理库、路由或完整的 SSR 框架设置。

wyattowalsh/agents/git-workflow.title: git-workflow
wyattowalsh/agents/git-workflow.description: Git operations: conventional commits, PR descriptions, branch strategy, conflict resolution, code archaeology, bisect. Use for git workflow tasks. NOT for code review, CI/CD, or changelogs.
wyattowalsh/agents/git-workflow.descriptionEn: Git operations: conventional commits, PR descriptions, branch strategy, conflict resolution, code archaeology, bisect. Use for git workflow tasks. NOT for code review, CI/CD, or changelogs.
wyattowalsh/agents/git-workflow.descriptionCn: Git 操作：常规提交、PR 描述、分支策略、冲突解决、代码考古、二等分。用于 git 工作流程任务。不适用于代码审查、CI/CD 或变更日志。

wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.title: honest-review
wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.description: Research-driven code review at multiple abstraction levels with strengths acknowledgment, creative review lenses, AI code smell detection, and severity calibration by project type. Two modes: (1) Session review — review and verify changes using parallel reviewers that research-validate every assumption; (2) Full codebase audit — deep end-to-end evaluation using parallel teams of subagent-spawning reviewers. Use when reviewing changes, verifying work quality, auditing a codebase, validating correctness, checking assumptions, finding defects, reducing complexity. NOT for writing new code, explaining code, or benchmarking.
wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.descriptionEn: Research-driven code review at multiple abstraction levels with strengths acknowledgment, creative review lenses, AI code smell detection, and severity calibration by project type. Two modes: (1) Session review — review and verify changes using parallel reviewers that research-validate every assumption; (2) Full codebase audit — deep end-to-end evaluation using parallel teams of subagent-spawning reviewers. Use when reviewing changes, verifying work quality, auditing a codebase, validating correctness, checking assumptions, finding defects, reducing complexity. NOT for writing new code, explaining code, or benchmarking.
wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.descriptionCn: 研究驱动的多个抽象级别的代码审查，包括优势认可、创意审查镜头、人工智能代码气味检测以及按项目类型进行的严重性校准。两种模式：（1）会议审查——使用平行审查者审查和验证变更，研究验证每个假设； (2) 完整的代码库审计——使用由子代理生成的审核者组成的平行团队进行深入的端到端评估。在审查变更、验证工作质量、审核代码库、验证正确性、检查假设、发现缺陷、降低复杂性时使用。不适用于编写新代码、解释代码或基准测试。

wyattowalsh/agents/host-panel.title: host-panel
wyattowalsh/agents/host-panel.description: Host simulated panel discussions and debates among AI-simulated domain experts. Supports roundtable, Oxford-style, and Socratic formats with heterogeneous expert personas, anti-groupthink mechanisms, and structured synthesis. Use when exploring complex topics from multiple expert perspectives, testing argument strength, academic brainstorming, or understanding trade-offs in decisions.
wyattowalsh/agents/host-panel.descriptionEn: Host simulated panel discussions and debates among AI-simulated domain experts. Supports roundtable, Oxford-style, and Socratic formats with heterogeneous expert personas, anti-groupthink mechanisms, and structured synthesis. Use when exploring complex topics from multiple expert perspectives, testing argument strength, academic brainstorming, or understanding trade-offs in decisions.
wyattowalsh/agents/host-panel.descriptionCn: 在人工智能模拟领域专家之间主持模拟小组讨论和辩论。支持圆桌会议、牛津式和苏格拉底式格式，具有异构专家角色、反群体思维机制和结构化综合。在从多个专家角度探索复杂主题、测试论证强度、学术头脑风暴或理解决策中的权衡时使用。

wyattowalsh/agents/infrastructure-coder.title: infrastructure-coder
wyattowalsh/agents/infrastructure-coder.description: Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker. Generate, review, cost-compare, security-scan. Use for IaC work. NOT for CI/CD (devops-engineer), application code, or actual pricing.
wyattowalsh/agents/infrastructure-coder.descriptionEn: Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker. Generate, review, cost-compare, security-scan. Use for IaC work. NOT for CI/CD (devops-engineer), application code, or actual pricing.
wyattowalsh/agents/infrastructure-coder.descriptionCn: 基础设施即代码：Terraform、Kubernetes、Docker。生成、审查、成本比较、安全扫描。用于 IaC 工作。不适用于 CI/CD（devops 工程师）、应用程序代码或实际定价。

wyattowalsh/agents/javascript-convention.title: javascript-conventions
wyattowalsh/agents/javascript-convention.description: JavaScript/Node.js tooling conventions. Use when working on JS/TS files, package.json, or Node.js projects. Enforce pnpm for package management. NOT for Python projects, backend-only work, or shell scripts.
wyattowalsh/agents/javascript-convention.descriptionEn: JavaScript/Node.js tooling conventions. Use when working on JS/TS files, package.json, or Node.js projects. Enforce pnpm for package management. NOT for Python projects, backend-only work, or shell scripts.
wyattowalsh/agents/javascript-convention.descriptionCn: JavaScript/Node.js 工具约定。在处理 JS/TS 文件、package.json 或 Node.js 项目时使用。强制执行 pnpm 进行包管理。不适用于 Python 项目、仅后端工作或 shell 脚本。

wyattowalsh/agents/learn.title: learn
wyattowalsh/agents/learn.description: Capture corrections, insights, and patterns as reusable project knowledge. Routes learnings to the right instruction file. Applies kaizen: small improvements, error-proofing, standards work. Auto-invoked when a correction pattern is detected 3+ times. Also use manually when Claude makes a repeated mistake, discovers a non-obvious gotcha, or when you want to persist a workflow preference.
wyattowalsh/agents/learn.descriptionEn: Capture corrections, insights, and patterns as reusable project knowledge. Routes learnings to the right instruction file. Applies kaizen: small improvements, error-proofing, standards work. Auto-invoked when a correction pattern is detected 3+ times. Also use manually when Claude makes a repeated mistake, discovers a non-obvious gotcha, or when you want to persist a workflow preference.
wyattowalsh/agents/learn.descriptionCn: 捕获更正、见解和模式作为可重用的项目知识。将学习内容路由到正确的说明文件。应用改善：小改进、防错、标准工作。当检测到校正模式 3 次以上时自动调用。当 Claude 重复犯错误、发现不明显的问题或者当您想要保留工作流程首选项时，也可以手动使用。

wyattowalsh/agents/mcp-creator.title: mcp-creator
wyattowalsh/agents/mcp-creator.description: Build production-ready MCP servers using FastMCP v3. Guides research, scaffolding, tool/resource/prompt implementation, testing, and deployment. Targets FastMCP 3.0.0rc2 with Providers, Transforms, middleware, OAuth, and composition. Use when creating MCP servers, integrating APIs via MCP, converting OpenAPI specs or FastAPI apps, or troubleshooting FastMCP issues. NOT for building REST APIs, CLI tools, or non-MCP integrations.
wyattowalsh/agents/mcp-creator.descriptionEn: Build production-ready MCP servers using FastMCP v3. Guides research, scaffolding, tool/resource/prompt implementation, testing, and deployment. Targets FastMCP 3.0.0rc2 with Providers, Transforms, middleware, OAuth, and composition. Use when creating MCP servers, integrating APIs via MCP, converting OpenAPI specs or FastAPI apps, or troubleshooting FastMCP issues. NOT for building REST APIs, CLI tools, or non-MCP integrations.
wyattowalsh/agents/mcp-creator.descriptionCn: 使用 FastMCP v3 构建生产就绪的 MCP 服务器。指导研究、脚手架、工具/资源/提示实施、测试和部署。以 FastMCP 3.0.0rc2 为目标，包含提供程序、转换、中间件、OAuth 和组合。在创建 MCP 服务器、通过 MCP 集成 API、转换 OpenAPI 规范或 FastAPI 应用程序或对 FastMCP 问题进行故障排除时使用。不适用于构建 REST API、CLI 工具或非 MCP 集成。

wyattowalsh/agents/namer.title: namer
wyattowalsh/agents/namer.description: Name anything: projects, products, companies, packages. Generates creative names across linguistic archetypes, checks handle/username availability across platforms, checks domain availability with pricing, and ranks options with scored rationales. Use when naming projects, products, startups, packages, or brands. NOT for domain management (infrastructure-coder) or branding strategy beyond naming (host-panel).
wyattowalsh/agents/namer.descriptionEn: Name anything: projects, products, companies, packages. Generates creative names across linguistic archetypes, checks handle/username availability across platforms, checks domain availability with pricing, and ranks options with scored rationales. Use when naming projects, products, startups, packages, or brands. NOT for domain management (infrastructure-coder) or branding strategy beyond naming (host-panel).
wyattowalsh/agents/namer.descriptionCn: 说出任何东西：项目、产品、公司、包。跨语言原型生成创意名称，检查跨平台的句柄/用户名可用性，检查域名可用性和定价，并根据评分理由对选项进行排名。在命名项目、产品、初创公司、包或品牌时使用。不适用于域管理（基础设施编码器）或命名之外的品牌策略（主机面板）。

wyattowalsh/agents/orchestrator.title: orchestrator
wyattowalsh/agents/orchestrator.description: Build and deploy parallel execution via subagent waves, agent teams, and multi-wave pipelines. Use when the Decomposition Gate identifies 2+ independent actions or when spawning teams. NOT for single-action tasks or non-parallel work.
wyattowalsh/agents/orchestrator.descriptionEn: Build and deploy parallel execution via subagent waves, agent teams, and multi-wave pipelines. Use when the Decomposition Gate identifies 2+ independent actions or when spawning teams. NOT for single-action tasks or non-parallel work.
wyattowalsh/agents/orchestrator.descriptionCn: 通过子代理wave、代理团队和多波管道构建和部署并行执行。当分解门识别出 2 个以上独立行动或生成团队时使用。不适用于单一操作任务或非并行工作。

wyattowalsh/agents/performance-profiler.title: performance-profiler
wyattowalsh/agents/performance-profiler.description: Performance analysis: complexity estimation, profiler output parsing, caching design, regression risk. Use for optimization guidance. NOT for running profilers, load tests, or monitoring.
wyattowalsh/agents/performance-profiler.descriptionEn: Performance analysis: complexity estimation, profiler output parsing, caching design, regression risk. Use for optimization guidance. NOT for running profilers, load tests, or monitoring.
wyattowalsh/agents/performance-profiler.descriptionCn: 性能分析：复杂性估计、分析器输出解析、缓存设计、回归风险。用于优化指导。不适用于运行分析器、负载测试或监控。

wyattowalsh/agents/prompt-engineer.title: prompt-engineer
wyattowalsh/agents/prompt-engineer.description: Comprehensive prompt and context engineering for any AI system. Four modes: (1) Craft new prompts from scratch, (2) Analyze existing prompts with diagnostic scoring and optional improvement, (3) Convert prompts between model families (Claude/GPT/Gemini/Llama), (4) Evaluate prompts with test suites and rubrics. Adapts all recommendations to model class (instruction-following vs reasoning). Validates findings against current documentation. Use for system prompts, agent prompts, RAG pipelines, tool definitions, or any LLM context design. NOT for running prompts, generating content, or building agents.
wyattowalsh/agents/prompt-engineer.descriptionEn: Comprehensive prompt and context engineering for any AI system. Four modes: (1) Craft new prompts from scratch, (2) Analyze existing prompts with diagnostic scoring and optional improvement, (3) Convert prompts between model families (Claude/GPT/Gemini/Llama), (4) Evaluate prompts with test suites and rubrics. Adapts all recommendations to model class (instruction-following vs reasoning). Validates findings against current documentation. Use for system prompts, agent prompts, RAG pipelines, tool definitions, or any LLM context design. NOT for running prompts, generating content, or building agents.
wyattowalsh/agents/prompt-engineer.descriptionCn: 适用于任何人工智能系统的全面提示和上下文工程。四种模式：(1) 从头开始​​制作新提示，(2) 通过诊断评分和可选改进来分析现有提示，(3) 在模型系列（Claude/GPT/Gemini/Llama）之间转换提示，(4) 使用测试套件和评分标准评估提示。将所有建议调整为模型类（指令遵循与推理）。根据当前文档验证结果。用于系统提示、代理提示、RAG 管道、工具定义或任何 LLM 上下文设计。不适用于运行提示、生成内容或构建代理。

wyattowalsh/agents/python-conventions.title: python-conventions
wyattowalsh/agents/python-conventions.description: Python tooling conventions. Use when working on .py files, pyproject.toml, or Python projects. Enforce uv for package management, ty for type checking. NOT for JavaScript/TypeScript projects or shell scripts.
wyattowalsh/agents/python-conventions.descriptionEn: Python tooling conventions. Use when working on .py files, pyproject.toml, or Python projects. Enforce uv for package management, ty for type checking. NOT for JavaScript/TypeScript projects or shell scripts.
wyattowalsh/agents/python-conventions.descriptionCn: Python 工具约定。在处理 .py 文件、pyproject.toml 或 Python 项目时使用。强制执行 uv 进行包管理，强制执行 ty 进行类型检查。不适用于 JavaScript/TypeScript 项目或 shell 脚本。

wyattowalsh/agents/reasoning-router.title: reasoning-router
wyattowalsh/agents/reasoning-router.description: Classify problems and route to optimal thinking MCP (11 available). Monitor confidence, re-route on stall. Use for complex reasoning. NOT for simple questions (answer directly) or code review (honest-review).
wyattowalsh/agents/reasoning-router.descriptionEn: Classify problems and route to optimal thinking MCP (11 available). Monitor confidence, re-route on stall. Use for complex reasoning. NOT for simple questions (answer directly) or code review (honest-review).
wyattowalsh/agents/reasoning-router.descriptionCn: 对问题进行分类并引导至最佳思维 MCP（11 个可用）。监控信心，在失速时重新调整路线。用于复杂推理。不适用于简单问题（直接回答）或代码审查（诚实审查）。

wyattowalsh/agents/research.title: research
wyattowalsh/agents/research.description: Deep multi-source research with confidence scoring. Auto-classifies complexity. Use for technical investigation, fact-checking. NOT for code review or simple Q&A.
wyattowalsh/agents/research.descriptionEn: Deep multi-source research with confidence scoring. Auto-classifies complexity. Use for technical investigation, fact-checking. NOT for code review or simple Q&A.
wyattowalsh/agents/research.descriptionCn: 具有置信度评分的深入多源研究。自动对复杂性进行分类。用于技术调查、事实核查。不适用于代码审查或简单的问答。

wyattowalsh/agents/security-scanner.title: security-scanner
wyattowalsh/agents/security-scanner.description: Proactive security assessment with SAST, secrets detection, dependency scanning, and compliance checks. Use for pre-deployment audit. NOT for code review (honest-review) or pen testing.
wyattowalsh/agents/security-scanner.descriptionEn: Proactive security assessment with SAST, secrets detection, dependency scanning, and compliance checks. Use for pre-deployment audit. NOT for code review (honest-review) or pen testing.
wyattowalsh/agents/security-scanner.descriptionCn: 使用 SAST、秘密检测、依赖性扫描和合规性检查进行主动安全评估。用于部署前审核。不适用于代码审查（诚实审查）或笔测试。

wyattowalsh/agents/shell-scripter.title: shell-scripter
wyattowalsh/agents/shell-scripter.description: Shell script generation, review, and dialect conversion. Makefile and justfile generation. ShellCheck rules. Use for shell work. NOT for Python (python-conventions) or CI/CD (devops-engineer).
wyattowalsh/agents/shell-scripter.descriptionEn: Shell script generation, review, and dialect conversion. Makefile and justfile generation. ShellCheck rules. Use for shell work. NOT for Python (python-conventions) or CI/CD (devops-engineer).
wyattowalsh/agents/shell-scripter.descriptionCn: Shell 脚本生成、审查和方言转换。 Makefile and justfile generation. ShellCheck 规则。用于外壳工作。不适用于 Python (python-conventions) 或 CI/CD (devops-engineer)。

wyattowalsh/agents/skill-creator.title: skill-creator
wyattowalsh/agents/skill-creator.description: Create, improve, and audit AI agent skills. Applies 14 proven structural patterns, scores quality with deterministic audit, manages full lifecycle. Use when building, refactoring, or reviewing skills. NOT for agents, MCP servers, or running existing skills.
wyattowalsh/agents/skill-creator.descriptionEn: Create, improve, and audit AI agent skills. Applies 14 proven structural patterns, scores quality with deterministic audit, manages full lifecycle. Use when building, refactoring, or reviewing skills. NOT for agents, MCP servers, or running existing skills.
wyattowalsh/agents/skill-creator.descriptionCn: 创建、改进和审核 AI 代理技能。应用 14 种经过验证的结构模式，通过确定性审核对质量进行评分，管理整个生命周期。在构建、重构或审查技能时使用。不适用于代理、MCP 服务器或运行现有技能。

wyattowalsh/agents/tech-debt-analyzer.title: tech-debt-analyzer
wyattowalsh/agents/tech-debt-analyzer.description: Systematic tech debt inventory with complexity analysis, dead code detection, and remediation planning. Track debt over time. NOT for code review (honest-review) or refactoring.
wyattowalsh/agents/tech-debt-analyzer.descriptionEn: Systematic tech debt inventory with complexity analysis, dead code detection, and remediation planning. Track debt over time. NOT for code review (honest-review) or refactoring.
wyattowalsh/agents/tech-debt-analyzer.descriptionCn: 系统化的技术债务清单，包括复杂性分析、死代码检测和补救计划。随着时间的推移跟踪债务。不适用于代码审查（诚实审查）或重构。

wyattowalsh/agents/test-architect.title: test-architect

xiaomacoltai/bettafish-skill/bettafish-o.description:
BettaFish（微舆）多智能体舆情分析系统 - 基于 QueryAgent、MediaAgent、InsightAgent 三引擎并行架构，通过 ForumEngine 实现 Agent 间协作讨论，生成 Word/PDF + 高设计质量 HTML 双格式报告。

当用户需要以下分析时触发此 skill：
- 分析某品牌/企业/产品的社交媒体声誉和口碑
- 追踪热点舆情事件（如某车企被抨击、某明星争议事件）
- 挖掘特定社媒账号的内容和影响力数据
- 监测竞品舆情动态，进行多品牌对比
- 分析公众对某话题的情绪倾向和态度
- 生成舆情监测报告或危机预警分析
- 需要Word文档/PDF格式的正式报告
- 需要高设计质量的交互式HTML可视化报告
- 需要基于真实数据的深度舆情分析

此 skill 采用 QueryAgent + MediaAgent + InsightAgent 并行架构，通过 ForumEngine 实现 Agent 间讨论协作，执行 3 轮反思循环优化分析结果，最终输出:
1. **Word/PDF 文档** - 使用 docx/pdf subskill 生成，适合正式汇报、打印、存档
2. **高设计质量 HTML 报告** - 使用 frontend-design subskill，独特的编辑杂志风格，交互式可视化

**不使用任何数据库和模拟数据**，所有数据通过 WebSearch/WebFetch/Browser/Curl 实时获取。

支持完整开发工作流：读取任务 → 查找父需求 → 读取需求详情 → 创建提测单 → 编辑提测单 → 转给测试。
支持智能提测单完善：自动从 git 获取分支/提交信息，从 pom.xml 读取版本号，查找用户任务并填充提测单模板。

触发场景：
- 查询/修改云效任务状态
- 完善提测单内容（自动收集 git 信息）
- 创建提测单子任务
- 查看个人待处理任务
- 读取需求详情

触发词：云效、任务管理、工作项、修改状态、提测、提测单、完善提测单、SARW、EZML、IXXP、云效任务
xu-cell/ai-engineering-init/yunxiao-task.descriptionCn:
阿里云云霄项目协作和任务管理技能。通过云霄开放API直接操作工作项：查询任务、更改状态、编辑描述、添加评论、记录工时、创建子任务、搜索项目等。  
支持完整的开发工作流程：读取任务→查找父需求→读取需求详细信息→创建测试请求表单→编辑测试请求表单→移交给QA。  
支持智能测试请求表单丰富：自动从 git 获取分支/提交信息，从 pom.xml 读取版本号，定位用户任务并填充测试请求模板。

触发场景：  
- 查询/修改云霄任务状态  
- 丰富测试请求表单内容（自动收集 git 信息）  
- 创建测试请求子任务  
- 查看个人待处理任务  
- 阅读要求详细信息  

触发词：云霄、任务管理、工作项、更改状态、测试请求、测试请求表单、丰富测试请求表单、SARW、EZML、IXXP、云霄任务

yangxunj/claude-code-session-manager/ses.title: session-manager
yangxunj/claude-code-session-manager/ses.description:
Session expert management system for Claude Code projects. Enables tracking, routing, activating, and registering conversation sessions as domain experts. Use this skill when:
(1) Setting up session management for a new project (initialization)
(2) A user requests a feature change, bug fix, or optimization and you need to check if a session expert already handles that domain (routing)
(3) A session has accumulated deep domain context and should register itself as an expert (registration)
(4) An existing session expert needs to update its registration after scope changes (update)
(5) A session is expired and needs to be activated for resuming (activation)
(6) The user asks about managing, organizing, or optimizing session documentation
