zpankz/mcp-skillset/skills-router.descriptionCn: 使用语义发现将任务路由到技能数据库和技能库中的技能。触发专门技能要求、特定领域任务或明确的技能请求。使用技能发现、mcp-skillset 和技能-rag-router 进行语义匹配。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/software-architectur.title: software-architecture
zpankz/mcp-skillset/software-architectur.description: Guide for quality focused software architecture. This skill should be used when users want to write code, design architecture, analyze code, in any case that relates to software development.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/software-architectur.descriptionEn: Guide for quality focused software architecture. This skill should be used when users want to write code, design architecture, analyze code, in any case that relates to software development.

zpankz/mcp-skillset/spec-writer.title: spec-writer
zpankz/mcp-skillset/spec-writer.description: This skill should be used when writing technical specifications, architecture documents, or design proposals that require structured analysis, clear documentation, and actionable implementation plans.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/spec-writer.descriptionEn: This skill should be used when writing technical specifications, architecture documents, or design proposals that require structured analysis, clear documentation, and actionable implementation plans.

zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-driven-deve.title: subagent-driven-development
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-driven-deve.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session or facing 3+ independent issues that can be investigated without shared state or dependencies - dispatches fresh subagent for each task with code review between tasks, enabling fast iteration with quality gates
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-driven-deve.descriptionEn: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session or facing 3+ independent issues that can be investigated without shared state or dependencies - dispatches fresh subagent for each task with code review between tasks, enabling fast iteration with quality gates
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-driven-deve.descriptionCn: 在当前会话中执行具有独立任务的实施计划或面临 3 个以上独立问题时使用，这些问题可以在没有共享状态或依赖关系的情况下进行调查 - 为每个任务分派新的子代理，并在任务之间进行代码审查，从而通过质量门实现快速迭代

zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-prompt-cons.title: subagent-prompt-construction

zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.title: suno-song
zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.description: Transform diverse inputs (YouTube videos/audio, existing Suno songs, raw lyrics, audio files, or conversational ideas) into highly optimized Suno V5 custom song generation prompts with intelligent character optimization (5000 lyrics, 1000 style limits), proven metatag reliability, V5-enhanced emotion tags, and template-based best practices. zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.descriptionEn: Transform diverse inputs (YouTube videos/audio, existing Suno songs, raw lyrics, audio files, or conversational ideas) into highly optimized Suno V5 custom song generation prompts with intelligent character optimization (5000 lyrics, 1000 style limits), proven metatag reliability, V5-enhanced emotion tags, and template-based best practices. zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.descriptionCn: 通过智能字符优化（5000 句歌词、1000 种风格限制）、经过验证的元标签可靠性、V5 增强型情感标签和基于模板的最佳实践，将各种输入（YouTube 视频/音频、现有 Suno 歌曲、原始歌词、音频文件或对话想法）转换为高度优化的 Suno V5 自定义歌曲生成提示。当用户想要使用 Suno 创建音乐、提供歌曲生成内容或需要帮助制作有效的 V5 提示时使用。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/tapestry.title: tapestry
zpankz/mcp-skillset/tapestry.description: Unified content extraction and action planning. zpankz/mcp-skillset/tapestry.descriptionCn: 统一的内容提取和行动规划。当用户说“tapestry [URL]”、“weave [URL]”、“help me plan [URL]”、“extract and plan [URL]”、“make this actionable [URL]”或类似短语表示他们想要提取内容并创建行动计划时使用。自动检测内容类型（YouTube 视频、文章、PDF）并进行相应处理。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.title: Technical Debt Management
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.description: Systematic technical debt quantification and management using SQALE methodology with value-effort prioritization, phased paydown roadmaps, and prevention strategies. Use when technical debt unmeasured or subjective, need objective prioritization, planning refactoring work, establishing debt prevention practices, or tracking debt trends over time. Provides 6 methodology components (measurement with SQALE index, categorization with code smell taxonomy, prioritization with value-effort matrix, phased paydown roadmap, trend tracking system, prevention guidelines), 3 patterns (SQALE-based quantification, code smell taxonomy mapping, value-effort prioritization), 3 principles (high-value low-effort first, SQALE provides objective baseline, complexity drives maintainability debt). Validated with 4.5x speedup vs manual approach, 85% transferability across languages (Go, Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust), SQALE industry-standard methodology.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.descriptionEn: Systematic technical debt quantification and management using SQALE methodology with value-effort prioritization, phased paydown roadmaps, and prevention strategies. Use when technical debt unmeasured or subjective, need objective prioritization, planning refactoring work, establishing debt prevention practices, or tracking debt trends over time. Provides 6 methodology components (measurement with SQALE index, categorization with code smell taxonomy, prioritization with value-effort matrix, phased paydown roadmap, trend tracking system, prevention guidelines), 3 patterns (SQALE-based quantification, code smell taxonomy mapping, value-effort prioritization), 3 principles (high-value low-effort first, SQALE provides objective baseline, complexity drives maintainability debt). Validated with 4.5x speedup vs manual approach, 85% transferability across languages (Go, Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust), SQALE industry-standard methodology.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.descriptionCn: 使用 SQALE 方法进行系统性技术债务量化和管理，并确定价值努力优先级、分阶段还款路线图和预防策略。当技术债务无法衡量或主观、需要客观优先级、规划重构工作、建立债务预防实践或跟踪一段时间内的债务趋势时使用。提供 6 个方法组件（使用 SQALE 指数进行测量、使用代码异味分类法进行分类、使用价值-努力矩阵进行优先级排序、分阶段支付路线图、趋势跟踪系统、预防指南）、3 个模式（基于 SQALE 的量化、代码异味分类映射、价值-努力优先级排序）、3 个原则（高价值低努力优先、SQALE 提供客观基线、复杂性驱动可维护性债务）。经过验证，与手动方法相比，速度提高了 4.5 倍，跨语言（Go、Python、JavaScript、Java、Rust）的可移植性达到 85%，SQALE 行业标准方法。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/telos.title: telos
zpankz/mcp-skillset/telos.description: Teleological physiology analysis framework for understanding biological systems through multi-constraint optimization. Use when analyzing physiological mechanisms, explaining apparent biological "inefficiencies", preparing for medical examinations (CICM/ANZCA Primary), understanding why biological systems are designed the way they are, or when seeking deeper mechanistic understanding beyond descriptive knowledge. Triggers on questions like "why is X designed this way", "what purpose does Y serve", "how is Z optimized", analysis of physiological trade-offs, or exploration of evolutionary/design constraints.

zpankz/mcp-skillset/test-driven-developm.title: test-driven-development
zpankz/mcp-skillset/test-driven-developm.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code - write the test first, watch it fail, write minimal code to pass; ensures tests actually verify behavior by requiring failure first
zpankz/mcp-skillset/test-driven-developm.descriptionEn: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code - write the test first, watch it fail, write minimal code to pass; ensures tests actually verify behavior by requiring failure first

zpankz/mcp-skillset/testing-strategy.title: Testing Strategy
zpankz/mcp-skillset/testing-strategy.description: Systematic testing methodology for Go projects using TDD, coverage-driven gap closure, fixture patterns, and CLI testing. Use when establishing test strategy from scratch, improving test coverage from 60-75% to 80%+, creating test infrastructure with mocks and fixtures, building CLI test suites, or systematizing ad-hoc testing. Provides 8 documented patterns (table-driven, golden file, fixture, mocking, CLI testing, integration, helper utilities, coverage-driven gap closure), 3 automation tools (coverage analyzer 186x speedup, test generator 200x speedup, methodology guide 7.5x speedup). Validated across 3 project archetypes with 3.1x average speedup, 5.8% adaptation effort, 89% transferability to Python/Rust/TypeScript.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/testing-strategy.descriptionEn: Systematic testing methodology for Go projects using TDD, coverage-driven gap closure, fixture patterns, and CLI testing. Use when establishing test strategy from scratch, improving test coverage from 60-75% to 80%+, creating test infrastructure with mocks and fixtures, building CLI test suites, or systematizing ad-hoc testing. Provides 8 documented patterns (table-driven, golden file, fixture, mocking, CLI testing, integration, helper utilities, coverage-driven gap closure), 3 automation tools (coverage analyzer 186x speedup, test generator 200x speedup, methodology guide 7.5x speedup). Validated across 3 project archetypes with 3.1x average speedup, 5.8% adaptation effort, 89% transferability to Python/Rust/TypeScript.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/testing-strategy.descriptionCn: 使用 TDD、覆盖驱动的间隙闭合、夹具模式和 CLI 测试的 Go 项目的系统测试方法。在从头开始建立测试策略、将测试覆盖率从 60-75% 提高到 80% 以上、使用模拟和固定装置创建测试基础设施、构建 CLI 测试套件或系统化临时测试时使用。提供 8 个记录模式（表驱动、黄金文件、夹具、模拟、CLI 测试、集成、辅助实用程序、覆盖率驱动的差距闭合）、3 个自动化工具（覆盖率分析器 186 倍加速、测试生成器 200 倍加速、方法指南 7.5 倍加速）。在 3 个项目原型中进行了验证，平均加速率为 3.1 倍，适应工作量为 5.8%，Python/Rust/TypeScript 的可迁移性为 89%。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/textbook-grounding.title: textbook-grounding

zpankz/mcp-skillset/theme-factory.title: theme-factory

zsy1207/atmospheric-science-research-ski.description: Use this skill for file-based atmospheric or climate work with a real project structure rather than a one-off answer. Trigger it for NetCDF, GRIB, reanalysis, ERA5, CMIP, WRF, model output, EOF or PCA, climatology, anomaly, regression, composite, or other atmospheric diagnostics when the task involves planning, diagnostics or statistics, regridding, reusable computation, compute-vs-plot separation, publication-grade figures, or review of actual outputs. Also use it for existing atmospheric figure files or small figure-only patches inside an existing atmospheric or climate project when labels, levels, colorbars, legends, panel letters, layout, or exports need fixing without changing the scientific method. Do not use it for forecasts, literature summaries, pure writing, generic plotting outside atmospheric science, app or UI work, deployment, or simple one-step downloads.
